{% block extra_js %}
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
<script>
    // Prevent auto-escaping of JSON in template output
    const napboxes = {{ napboxesJson| safe }};
    const customers = {{ customersJson| safe }};

    function computeCenterFromBoth(napArr, custArr) {
        const all = [];
        napArr.forEach(n => {
            if (n.nap_latitude && n.nap_longitude) {
                all.push({ lat: parseFloat(n.nap_latitude), lng: parseFloat(n.nap_longitude) });
            }
        });
        custArr.forEach(c => {
            if (c.latitude && c.longitude) {
                all.push({ lat: parseFloat(c.latitude), lng: parseFloat(c.longitude) });
            }
        });
        // Default fallback center
        if (!all.length) return { lat: 8.483800, lng: 124.626868 };
        let sumLat = 0, sumLng = 0;
        all.forEach(p => {
            sumLat += p.lat;
            sumLng += p.lng;
        });
        return { lat: sumLat / all.length, lng: sumLng / all.length };
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const center = computeCenterFromBoth(napboxes, customers);
        const hasAny = napboxes.length || customers.length;

        const map = L.map('map').setView([center.lat, center.lng], hasAny ? 13 : 8);

        L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
            maxZoom: 19,
            attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors'
        }).addTo(map);

        const allowedColors = ['red', 'blue', 'green', 'orange', 'yellow', 'violet', 'grey', 'black'];
        const napIconsByColor = {};

        function getNapIconByColor(color) {
            let c = (color || '').toLowerCase().trim();
            if (!allowedColors.includes(c)) {
                c = 'red';
            }
            if (!napIconsByColor[c]) {
                napIconsByColor[c] = new L.Icon({
                    iconUrl: 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pointhi/leaflet-color-markers/master/img/marker-icon-' + c + '.png',
                    shadowUrl: 'https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/images/marker-shadow.png',
                    iconSize: [25, 41],
                    iconAnchor: [12, 41],
                    popupAnchor: [1, -34],
                    shadowSize: [41, 41]
                });
            }
            return napIconsByColor[c];
        }

        // Customer marker icons
        const blueIcon = new L.Icon({
            iconUrl: 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pointhi/leaflet-color-markers/master/img/marker-icon-blue.png',
            shadowUrl: 'https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/images/marker-shadow.png',
            iconSize: [25, 41],
            iconAnchor: [12, 41],
            popupAnchor: [1, -34],
            shadowSize: [41, 41]
        });
        const blackIcon = new L.Icon({
            iconUrl: 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pointhi/leaflet-color-markers/master/img/marker-icon-black.png',
            shadowUrl: 'https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/images/marker-shadow.png',
            iconSize: [25, 41],
            iconAnchor: [12, 41],
            popupAnchor: [1, -34],
            shadowSize: [41, 41]
        });

        const bounds = [];
        const markers = [];
        const dirty = {};

        function makeDirtyKey(type, id) {
            return type + ':' + id;
        }

        // --- NAP BOX MARKERS ---
        napboxes.forEach(n => {
            const lat = parseFloat(n.nap_latitude);
            const lng = parseFloat(n.nap_longitude);
            if (isNaN(lat) || isNaN(lng)) return;

            const icon = getNapIconByColor(n.marker_color);
            const marker = L.marker([lat, lng], {
                icon,
                draggable: true
            }).addTo(map);

            const popupHtml = (latNow, lngNow) =>
                '<strong>NAP: ' + (n.napbox_no || '-') + '</strong><br>' +
                'Lat: ' + latNow.toFixed(6) + '<br>' +
                'Lng: ' + lngNow.toFixed(6) + '<br>' +
                'Color: ' + (n.marker_color || 'default (red)') +
                '<small class="coord-info">(Drag pin to change position, then click "Save Changes")</small>';

            marker.bindPopup(popupHtml(lat, lng));

            marker.on('dragend', function (e) {
                const newPos = e.target.getLatLng();
                dirty[makeDirtyKey('nap', n.id)] = {
                    type: 'nap',
                    id: n.id,
                    lat: newPos.lat,
                    lng: newPos.lng
                };
                marker.setPopupContent(popupHtml(newPos.lat, newPos.lng));
                document.getElementById('save-status').textContent = 'You have unsaved changes.';
            });

            markers.push({ type: 'nap', marker, data: n, lat, lng });
            bounds.push([lat, lng]);
        });

        // --- CUSTOMER MARKERS ---
        customers.forEach(c => {
            const lat = parseFloat(c.latitude);
            const lng = parseFloat(c.longitude);
            if (isNaN(lat) || isNaN(lng)) return;

            const isConnected = (String(c.is_connected) === '1');
            const icon = isConnected ? blueIcon : blackIcon;

            const marker = L.marker([lat, lng], {
                icon,
                draggable: true
            }).addTo(map);

            const detailUrl = '/customers/edit/' + encodeURIComponent(c.id) + '/';

            const popupHtml = (latNow, lngNow) =>
                '<strong>' + (c.full_name || 'Unknown') + '</strong><br>' +
                'Username: ' + (c.username || '-') + '<br>' +
                'Lat: ' + latNow.toFixed(6) + '<br>' +
                'Lng: ' + lngNow.toFixed(6) + '<br>' +
                '<span>Status: <b>' + (isConnected ? 'Active' : 'Inactive') + '</b></span><br>' +
                '<a href="' + detailUrl + '" class="btn-view-mt mt-2">➡ View Details</a>' +
                '<small class="coord-info">(Drag pin to change position, then click "Save Changes")</small>';

            marker.bindPopup(popupHtml(lat, lng));

            marker.on('dblclick', function () {
                window.location.href = detailUrl;
            });

            marker.on('dragend', function (e) {
                const newPos = e.target.getLatLng();
                dirty[makeDirtyKey('customer', c.id)] = {
                    type: 'customer',
                    id: c.id,
                    lat: newPos.lat,
                    lng: newPos.lng
                };
                marker.setPopupContent(popupHtml(newPos.lat, newPos.lng));
                document.getElementById('save-status').textContent = 'You have unsaved changes.';
            });

            markers.push({ type: 'customer', marker, data: c, lat, lng });
            bounds.push([lat, lng]);
        });

        if (bounds.length > 1) {
            map.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: [30, 30] });
        }

        // --- SEARCH LOGIC ---
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('map-search-input');
        const searchBtn = document.getElementById('map-search-btn');
        const searchMsg = document.getElementById('map-search-msg');

        function runSearch() {
            const q = (searchInput.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            searchMsg.textContent = '';

            if (!q) {
                searchMsg.textContent = 'Type NAP, customer name, or username to search.';
                return;
            }

            let match = markers.find(m => {
                if (m.type !== 'customer') return false;
                const name = (m.data.full_name || '').toLowerCase();
                const user = (m.data.username || '').toLowerCase();
                return name.includes(q) || user.includes(q);
            });

            if (!match) {
                match = markers.find(m => {
                    if (m.type !== 'nap') return false;
                    const nb = (m.data.napbox_no || '').toLowerCase();
                    return nb.includes(q);
                });
            }

            if (!match) {
                searchMsg.textContent = 'No matching record found.';
                return;
            }

            map.setView([match.lat, match.lng], 15);
            match.marker.openPopup();

            if (match.type === 'customer') {
                searchMsg.textContent = 'Showing customer: ' + (match.data.full_name || match.data.username || 'Unknown');
            } else {
                searchMsg.textContent = 'Showing NAP: ' + (match.data.napbox_no || '-');
            }
        }

        searchBtn.addEventListener('click', runSearch);
        searchInput.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') runSearch();
        });

        // --- SAVE CHANGES ---
        const saveBtn = document.getElementById('save-changes-btn');
        const saveStatus = document.getElementById('save-status');

        saveBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            const changes = Object.values(dirty);
            if (!changes.length) {
                saveStatus.textContent = 'No changes to save.';
                return;
            }

            if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to save the changes?')) {
                return;
            }

            saveStatus.textContent = 'Saving...';

            fetch('{% url "save_marker_positions" %}', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'X-CSRFToken': '{{ csrf_token }}'
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(changes)
            })
                .then(res => res.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data && data.success) {
                        for (const k in dirty) {
                            if (Object.hasOwn(dirty, k)) delete dirty[k];
                        }
                        saveStatus.textContent = 'Changes saved successfully.';
                    } else {
                        saveStatus.textContent = data && data.message ? 'Error: ' + data.message : 'Error saving changes.';
                    }
                })
                .catch(err => {
                    console.error(err);
                    saveStatus.textContent = 'Error saving changes (network/server).';
                });
        });
    });
</script>
{% endblock %}

    <script>
        function togglePassword() {
            const pwField = document.getElementById('passwordField');
            const eyeIcon = document.querySelector('.eye-icon');
            if (pwField.type === "password") {
                pwField.type = "text";
                eyeIcon.classList.remove('fa-eye');
                eyeIcon.classList.add('fa-eye-slash');
            } else {
                pwField.type = "password";
                eyeIcon.classList.remove('fa-eye-slash');
                eyeIcon.classList.add('fa-eye');
            }
        }

        function toggleMobileLogin() {
            document.querySelector('.form-section').classList.toggle('show');
            document.querySelector('.mobile-overlay').classList.toggle('show');
        }

        // Auto-show form on mobile if there are validation errors
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            {% if form.errors or error or messages %}
            if (window.innerWidth <= 900) {
                toggleMobileLogin();
            }
            {% endif %}
        });

        // Prevent multiple form submissions and show feedback
        document.querySelector('form').addEventListener('submit', function () {
            const btn = document.getElementById('loginBtn');
            const text = document.getElementById('btnText');
            btn.style.opacity = '0.7';
            btn.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
            text.textContent = 'Authenticating...';
        });
    </script>

<script>
function editService(pk, name, target, type) {
    document.getElementById('form-pk').value = pk;
    document.getElementById('form-name').value = name;
    document.getElementById('form-target').value = target;
    document.getElementById('form-type').value = type;
    document.getElementById('form-action-label').textContent = 'Edit Service';
    document.getElementById('form-submit-label').textContent = 'Save Changes';
    document.getElementById('cancel-btn').style.display = '';
    document.getElementById('form-name').focus();
    window.scrollTo({top: 0, behavior: 'smooth'});
}
function resetForm() {
    document.getElementById('service-form').reset();
    document.getElementById('form-pk').value = '';
    document.getElementById('form-action-label').textContent = 'Add New Service';
    document.getElementById('form-submit-label').textContent = 'Add Service';
    document.getElementById('cancel-btn').style.display = 'none';
}
</script>

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const container = document.getElementById('async-data-container');
    fetch(`/mikrotik-active-users/api/data/`)
        .then(response => {
            if(!response.ok) throw new Error('Network response was not ok');
            return response.text();
        })
        .then(html => {
            container.innerHTML = html;
            var activeTable = $('#activeUsersTable').DataTable({
                order: [[0,'asc']], pageLength: 10,
                language: { search: '', searchPlaceholder: 'Search users...' }
            });
            var offlineTable = $('#offlineUsersTable').DataTable({
                order: [[0,'asc']], pageLength: 10,
                language: {
                    search: '', searchPlaceholder: 'Search customers...',
                    emptyTable: "<div class='py-4 text-muted'><i class='fas fa-check-circle text-success fs-3 mb-2 d-block'></i>All assigned customers are currently online.</div>"
                }
            });
            $('#routerFilter').on('change', function() {
                var val = this.value;
                activeTable.column(2).search(val).draw();
                offlineTable.column(3).search(val).draw();
            });
        })
        .catch(error => {
            console.error('Error:', error);
            container.innerHTML = `
                <div class="dashboard-card" style="overflow:hidden;">
                    <div class="empty-state">
                        <div class="es-icon" style="color:#dc2626;"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i></div>
                        <h6>Error Loading Data</h6>
                        <p>Could not fetch router data. Please try refreshing the page.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        });
});
</script>

{% block extra_js %}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    function getCsrfToken() {
        const el = document.querySelector('[name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]');
        return el ? el.value : '';
    }

    // Mark single notification as read
    document.querySelectorAll('.mark-read-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const notifId = this.getAttribute('data-id');
            const card = document.querySelector(`.notif-item[data-id="${notifId}"]`);
            fetch(`/api/notifications/mark-read/${notifId}/`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'X-CSRFToken': getCsrfToken()}
            }).then(res => res.json()).then(data => {
                if(data.status === 'success') {
                    card.classList.remove('unread');
                    this.remove();
                    const badge = card.querySelector('.pill-pending');
                    if(badge) badge.remove();
                    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('notificationsUpdated'));
                }
            });
        });
    });

    // Mark all as read
    const pageMarkAllReadBtn = document.getElementById('pageMarkAllReadBtn');
    if(pageMarkAllReadBtn) {
        pageMarkAllReadBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            Swal.fire({
                title: 'Mark all as read?',
                text: "This will mark all your notifications as read.",
                icon: 'question',
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonColor: '#2563eb',
                cancelButtonColor: '#94a3b8',
                confirmButtonText: '<i class="fas fa-check-double me-1"></i>Yes, mark all',
                cancelButtonText: 'Cancel',
                borderRadius: '20px',
            }).then((result) => {
                if(result.isConfirmed) {
                    fetch('/api/notifications/mark-all-read/', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {'X-CSRFToken': getCsrfToken()}
                    }).then(res => res.json()).then(data => {
                        if(data.status === 'success') { window.location.reload(); }
                    });
                }
            });
        });
    }
});
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const monthlyPrice = parseFloat("{{ customer.plan.price|default:0 }}");
    const currentExpiryStr = "{{ customer.expires_at|date:'c' }}";
    
    // Parse Initial Date (Default Start Date)
    let initialDate = new Date();
    if (currentExpiryStr && currentExpiryStr !== 'None' && currentExpiryStr !== '') {
        let parsed = new Date(currentExpiryStr);
        if (!isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
            // Only use the current expiry if it's in the future!
            if (parsed > new Date()) {
                initialDate = parsed;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Set default value for Start Date input
    const startInput = document.getElementById('start_date');
    function formatInputDatetime(dt) {
        const pad = (n) => n < 10 ? '0'+n : n;
        return dt.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(dt.getMonth()+1) + '-' + pad(dt.getDate()) + 'T' + pad(dt.getHours()) + ':' + pad(dt.getMinutes());
    }
    startInput.value = formatInputDatetime(initialDate);
    
    // Setup Quick Pay Grid Math
    document.querySelectorAll('.calc-price').forEach(el => {
        if (el.hasAttribute('data-mult')) {
            let mult = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-mult'));
            el.textContent = (monthlyPrice * mult).toFixed(2);
        } else if (el.hasAttribute('data-days')) {
            let days = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-days'));
            el.textContent = ((monthlyPrice / 30) * days).toFixed(2);
        }
    });

    const amountInput = document.getElementById('amount');
    const reasonBlock = document.getElementById('reason-block');
    const reasonInput = document.getElementById('reason');
    const previewDateEl = document.getElementById('preview-date');
    const quickBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.quick-btn');

    function safeAddOneMonth(dt) {
        let year = dt.getFullYear();
        let month = dt.getMonth(); // 0-indexed
        let day = dt.getDate();
        let hours = dt.getHours();
        let mins = dt.getMinutes();
        let secs = dt.getSeconds();
        
        month += 1;
        if (month > 11) {
            month = 0;
            year += 1;
        }
        
        // Get max days in the new month
        let maxDays = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
        let safeDay = Math.min(day, maxDays);
        
        return new Date(year, month, safeDay, hours, mins, secs);
    }

    function calculateExpiryPreview(paymentAmount) {
        // Read dynamic start date
        let baseDate = new Date(startInput.value);
        if (isNaN(baseDate.getTime())) baseDate = new Date();

        if (monthlyPrice <= 0 || paymentAmount <= 0) {
            return baseDate;
        }
        
        let fullMonths = Math.floor(paymentAmount / monthlyPrice);
        let remainder = paymentAmount % monthlyPrice;
        
        let previewDate = new Date(baseDate.getTime());
        for(let i=0; i<fullMonths; i++) {
            previewDate = safeAddOneMonth(previewDate);
        }
        
        if (remainder > 0.01) {
            let pricePerDay = monthlyPrice / 30.0;
            let daysGranted = remainder / pricePerDay;
            previewDate = new Date(previewDate.getTime() + (daysGranted * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
        }
        
        return previewDate;
    }

    function updatePreview() {
        let amt = parseFloat(amountInput.value) || 0;
        let newDate = calculateExpiryPreview(amt);
        
        // Format nicely: e.g. "Oct 15, 2024, 10:30 AM"
        const options = { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' };
        previewDateEl.textContent = newDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', options);
        
        // Handle Reason block
        if (amt > 0 && amt % monthlyPrice !== 0) {
            reasonBlock.style.display = 'block';
            reasonInput.required = true;
        } else {
            reasonBlock.style.display = 'none';
            reasonInput.required = false;
        }
    }

    // Quick Button Click Handling
    quickBtns.forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            quickBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            btn.classList.add('active');
            
            if (btn.hasAttribute('data-months')) {
                let months = btn.getAttribute('data-months');
                if (months === 'custom') {
                    amountInput.readOnly = false;
                    amountInput.focus();
                } else {
                    amountInput.readOnly = true;
                    amountInput.value = (monthlyPrice * parseInt(months)).toFixed(2);
                    updatePreview();
                }
            } else if (btn.hasAttribute('data-days')) {
                let days = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-days'));
                amountInput.readOnly = true;
                amountInput.value = ((monthlyPrice / 30) * days).toFixed(2);
                updatePreview();
            }
        });
    });

    // Inputs listeners
    amountInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
        // Only run if Custom is selected
        if (document.getElementById('btn-custom').classList.contains('active')) {
            updatePreview();
        }
    });

    startInput.addEventListener('change', updatePreview);

    // Payment method logic
    const paymentMethod = document.getElementById('payment_method');
    const refNo = document.getElementById('reference_no');
    
    paymentMethod.addEventListener('change', () => {
        if (paymentMethod.value === 'cash') {
            refNo.required = false;
        } else {
            refNo.required = true;
        }
    });

    // Initialize Page State
    amountInput.readOnly = true; // 1 Month is active by default
    amountInput.value = monthlyPrice.toFixed(2);
    updatePreview();
});
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const ctx = document.getElementById('salesChart').getContext('2d');
    const chartLabels = JSON.parse('{{ chart_labels_js|escapejs }}');
    const chartValues = JSON.parse('{{ chart_values_js|escapejs }}');
    function getChartTheme() {
        const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark-mode');
        return {
            grid: isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)',
            ticks: isDark ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b'
        };
    }
    let theme = getChartTheme();
    let salesChart = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'line',
        data: {
            labels: chartLabels,
            datasets: [{
                label: 'Sales (₱)',
                data: chartValues,
                borderColor: '#10b981',
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.1)',
                tension: 0.4,
                pointRadius: 4,
                pointBackgroundColor: '#10b981',
                borderWidth: 2.5,
                fill: true
            }]
        },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
            scales: {
                x: {
                    grid: { display: false },
                    ticks: { color: theme.ticks, maxRotation: 45, autoSkip: true, maxTicksLimit: 7 }
                },
                y: {
                    beginAtZero: true,
                    grid: { color: theme.grid },
                    ticks: { color: theme.ticks }
                }
            }
        }
    });
    window.addEventListener('themeChanged', () => {
        let t = getChartTheme();
        salesChart.options.scales.x.ticks.color = t.ticks;
        salesChart.options.scales.y.ticks.color = t.ticks;
        salesChart.options.scales.y.grid.color = t.grid;
        salesChart.update();
    });
});
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
    function copyReceipt() {
        // Build a clean text receipt without HTML
        const text = `PAYMENT RECEIPT\n------------------------\nCustomer: {{ customer.pppoe_username }}\nAction: {{ action_type }}\nPlan: {{ customer.plan.name|default:"N/A" }}\nAmount Paid: ₱{{ amount }}\nNew Expiry: {{ new_expiry }}\nProcessed By: {{ adjusted_by }}\n------------------------\nSystem Status: Database Updated`;
        
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
            const btn = document.getElementById('receiptCopyBtn');
            const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check me-2"></i> Copied!';
            btn.classList.replace('btn-dark', 'btn-success');
            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
                btn.classList.replace('btn-success', 'btn-dark');
            }, 2000);
        });
    }

    function copyMessengerTemplate() {
        const text = document.getElementById('messengerTemplate').value;
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
            const btn = document.getElementById('msgCopyBtn');
            const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check me-1"></i> Copied!';
            btn.classList.add('bg-success', 'text-white');
            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
                btn.classList.remove('bg-success', 'text-white');
            }, 2000);
        });
    }
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    let monthlyPrice = parseFloat("{{ customer.plan.price|default:0 }}");
    const currentExpiryStr = "{{ customer.expires_at|date:'c' }}";
    
    const hiddenPlanInput = document.getElementById('hidden_new_plan_id');
    const priceDisplay = document.getElementById('monthly-price-display');
    const planSelectBtn = document.getElementById('plan-select-btn');

    document.querySelectorAll('.select-plan-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            const planId = this.getAttribute('data-id');
            const planPrice = this.getAttribute('data-price');
            const planName = this.getAttribute('data-name');
            
            // Update hidden input
            hiddenPlanInput.value = planId;
            monthlyPrice = parseFloat(planPrice) || 0;
            
            // Update UI elements
            if (priceDisplay) priceDisplay.innerHTML = '<strong>₱' + monthlyPrice.toFixed(2) + '</strong>';
            if (planSelectBtn) planSelectBtn.innerHTML = planName + ' <i class="fas fa-chevron-down ms-2 fs-6"></i>';
            
            // Update active state in modal
            document.querySelectorAll('.plan-card').forEach(card => {
                card.style.boxShadow = 'none';
                const cardBtn = card.querySelector('.select-plan-btn');
                if (cardBtn) cardBtn.innerHTML = 'Select Plan';
            });
            const myCard = this.closest('.plan-card');
            myCard.style.boxShadow = '0 0 0 2px #10b981';
            this.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check-circle me-1"></i> Selected';
            
            // Close modal
            const modalEl = document.getElementById('planModal');
            const modalInstance = bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(modalEl);
            if (modalInstance) modalInstance.hide();
            
            // Recalculate grid buttons
            updateGridMath();
            
            // Trigger recalculation on the active button
            const activeBtn = document.querySelector('.quick-btn.active');
            if (activeBtn) activeBtn.click();
        });
    });

    // Parse Initial Date (Default Start Date)
    let initialDate = new Date();
    if (currentExpiryStr && currentExpiryStr !== 'None' && currentExpiryStr !== '') {
        let parsed = new Date(currentExpiryStr);
        if (!isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
            // Only use the current expiry if it's in the future!
            if (parsed > new Date()) {
                initialDate = parsed;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Set default value for Start Date input
    const startInput = document.getElementById('start_date');
    function formatInputDatetime(dt) {
        const pad = (n) => n < 10 ? '0'+n : n;
        return dt.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(dt.getMonth()+1) + '-' + pad(dt.getDate()) + 'T' + pad(dt.getHours()) + ':' + pad(dt.getMinutes());
    }
    startInput.value = formatInputDatetime(initialDate);
    
    // Setup Quick Pay Grid Math
    function updateGridMath() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.calc-price').forEach(el => {
            if (el.hasAttribute('data-mult')) {
                let mult = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-mult'));
                el.textContent = (monthlyPrice * mult).toFixed(2);
            } else if (el.hasAttribute('data-days')) {
                let days = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-days'));
                el.textContent = ((monthlyPrice / 30) * days).toFixed(2);
            }
        });
    }
    updateGridMath();

    const amountInput = document.getElementById('amount');
    const reasonBlock = document.getElementById('reason-block');
    const reasonInput = document.getElementById('reason');
    const previewDateEl = document.getElementById('preview-date');
    const quickBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.quick-btn');

    function safeAddOneMonth(dt) {
        let year = dt.getFullYear();
        let month = dt.getMonth(); // 0-indexed
        let day = dt.getDate();
        let hours = dt.getHours();
        let mins = dt.getMinutes();
        let secs = dt.getSeconds();
        
        month += 1;
        if (month > 11) {
            month = 0;
            year += 1;
        }
        
        // Get max days in the new month
        let maxDays = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
        let safeDay = Math.min(day, maxDays);
        
        return new Date(year, month, safeDay, hours, mins, secs);
    }

    function calculateExpiryPreview(paymentAmount) {
        // Read dynamic start date
        let baseDate = new Date(startInput.value);
        if (isNaN(baseDate.getTime())) baseDate = new Date();

        if (monthlyPrice <= 0 || paymentAmount <= 0) {
            return baseDate;
        }
        
        let fullMonths = Math.floor(paymentAmount / monthlyPrice);
        let remainder = paymentAmount % monthlyPrice;
        
        let previewDate = new Date(baseDate.getTime());
        for(let i=0; i<fullMonths; i++) {
            previewDate = safeAddOneMonth(previewDate);
        }
        
        if (remainder > 0.01) {
            let pricePerDay = monthlyPrice / 30.0;
            let daysGranted = remainder / pricePerDay;
            previewDate = new Date(previewDate.getTime() + (daysGranted * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
        }
        
        return previewDate;
    }

    function updatePreview() {
        let amt = parseFloat(amountInput.value) || 0;
        let newDate = calculateExpiryPreview(amt);
        
        // Format nicely: e.g. "Oct 15, 2024, 10:30 AM"
        const options = { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' };
        previewDateEl.textContent = newDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', options);
        
        // Handle Reason block
        if (amt > 0 && amt % monthlyPrice !== 0) {
            reasonBlock.style.display = 'block';
            reasonInput.required = true;
        } else {
            reasonBlock.style.display = 'none';
            reasonInput.required = false;
        }
    }

    // Quick Button Click Handling
    quickBtns.forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            quickBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            btn.classList.add('active');
            
            if (btn.hasAttribute('data-months')) {
                let months = btn.getAttribute('data-months');
                if (months === 'custom') {
                    amountInput.readOnly = false;
                    amountInput.focus();
                } else {
                    amountInput.readOnly = true;
                    amountInput.value = (monthlyPrice * parseInt(months)).toFixed(2);
                    updatePreview();
                }
            } else if (btn.hasAttribute('data-days')) {
                let days = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-days'));
                amountInput.readOnly = true;
                amountInput.value = ((monthlyPrice / 30) * days).toFixed(2);
                updatePreview();
            }
        });
    });

    // Inputs listeners
    amountInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
        // Only run if Custom is selected
        if (document.getElementById('btn-custom').classList.contains('active')) {
            updatePreview();
        }
    });

    startInput.addEventListener('change', updatePreview);

    // Payment method logic
    const paymentMethod = document.getElementById('payment_method');
    const refNo = document.getElementById('reference_no');
    
    paymentMethod.addEventListener('change', () => {
        if (paymentMethod.value === 'cash') {
            refNo.required = false;
        } else {
            refNo.required = true;
        }
    });

    // Initialize Page State
    amountInput.readOnly = true; // 1 Month is active by default
    amountInput.value = monthlyPrice.toFixed(2);
    updatePreview();
});
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
document.querySelectorAll('.btn-copy').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var phone = btn.getAttribute('data-phone');
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(phone);
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa fa-check text-success"></i>';
        setTimeout(function() { btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa fa-copy text-secondary"></i>'; }, 1000);
    });
});

let lastSmsMessage = '';
document.querySelectorAll('.btn-edit-sms').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var phone = btn.getAttribute('data-phone');
        var full_name = btn.getAttribute('data-full_name');
        var default_message = btn.getAttribute('data-default_message');
        
        document.getElementById('smsPhone').value = phone;
        document.getElementById('smsPhoneDisplay').innerText = full_name + " (" + phone + ")";
        
        let msg = lastSmsMessage || default_message;
        document.getElementById('smsMessage').value = msg;
        document.getElementById('smsPreview').innerText = msg;
        updateCharCount('smsMessage', 'smsCharCount', 'smsCharWarning');
        
        document.getElementById('smsMessage').dataset.fullName = full_name;
        document.getElementById('smsTemplates').selectedIndex = 0;
        
        new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('editSmsModal')).show();
    });
});

document.getElementById('smsTemplates').addEventListener('change', function() {
    let template = this.value;
    let msgField = document.getElementById('smsMessage');
    let fullName = msgField.dataset.fullName || '';
    if (template) {
        template = template.replace('{name}', fullName);
        msgField.value = template;
        msgField.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
    }
});

document.getElementById('smsMessage').addEventListener('input', function() {
    updateCharCount('smsMessage', 'smsCharCount', 'smsCharWarning');
    document.getElementById('smsPreview').innerText = this.value;
    lastSmsMessage = this.value;
});

// Bulk selection logic
let selectedPhones = new Set();
document.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox').forEach(function(cb) {
    cb.addEventListener('change', function() {
        let phone = cb.getAttribute('data-phone');
        if (cb.checked && phone && phone !== 'None' && phone.trim() !== '') {
            selectedPhones.add(phone);
        } else {
            selectedPhones.delete(phone);
        }
        updateBulkBar();
    });
});

document.getElementById('selectAll')?.addEventListener('change', function() {
    let allChecked = this.checked;
    document.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox').forEach(function(cb) {
        let phone = cb.getAttribute('data-phone');
        if (phone && phone !== 'None' && phone.trim() !== '') {
            cb.checked = allChecked;
            if (allChecked) {
                selectedPhones.add(phone);
            } else {
                selectedPhones.delete(phone);
            }
        } else {
            cb.checked = false; // Never check empty phones
        }
    });
    updateBulkBar();
});

function updateBulkBar() {
    let bar = document.getElementById('bulkBar');
    let count = document.getElementById('bulkCount');
    if (selectedPhones.size > 0) {
        bar.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
        count.textContent = `${selectedPhones.size} selected`;
    } else {
        bar.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
    }
}

document.getElementById('bulkClearBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
    selectedPhones.clear();
    document.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox').forEach(cb => cb.checked = false);
    if(document.getElementById('selectAll')) {
        document.getElementById('selectAll').checked = false;
    }
    updateBulkBar();
});

document.getElementById('bulkSendBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
    document.getElementById('bulkModalPhones').value = Array.from(selectedPhones).join(',');
    document.getElementById('bulkPhoneCountDisplay').innerText = selectedPhones.size + " Recipients Selected";
    
    let msg = localStorage.getItem('lastBulkMessage') || "Hello! Kindly renew your subscription. Thank you!";
    document.getElementById('bulkSmsMessage').value = msg;
    document.getElementById('bulkSmsPreview').innerText = msg;
    updateCharCount('bulkSmsMessage', 'bulkSmsCharCount', 'bulkSmsCharWarning');
    
    document.getElementById('bulkSmsTemplates').selectedIndex = 0;
    
    new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('bulkSmsModal')).show();
});

document.getElementById('bulkSmsTemplates').addEventListener('change', function() {
    let template = this.value;
    let msgField = document.getElementById('bulkSmsMessage');
    if (template) {
        msgField.value = template;
        msgField.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
    }
});

document.getElementById('bulkSmsMessage').addEventListener('input', function() {
    updateCharCount('bulkSmsMessage', 'bulkSmsCharCount', 'bulkSmsCharWarning');
    document.getElementById('bulkSmsPreview').innerText = this.value;
    localStorage.setItem('lastBulkMessage', this.value);
});

function updateCharCount(textareaId, counterId, warningId) {
    let len = document.getElementById(textareaId).value.length;
    document.getElementById(counterId).innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-pencil-alt me-1"></i> ' + len + '/160';
    if (len > 160) {
        document.getElementById(warningId).classList.remove('d-none');
    } else {
        document.getElementById(warningId).classList.add('d-none');
    }
}
</script>
{% endblock %}
{% endblock %}

{% block extra_js %}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const container = document.getElementById('async-data-container');
    const queryString = window.location.search;
    fetch(`/subscriptions/api/data/${queryString}`)
        .then(response => {
            if(!response.ok) throw new Error('Network response was not ok');
            return response.text();
        })
        .then(html => { 
            container.innerHTML = html;
            initCheckboxes(); 
        })
        .catch(error => {
            console.error('Error fetching subscription data:', error);
            container.innerHTML = `
                <div class="dashboard-card" style="overflow:hidden;">
                    <div class="empty-state">
                        <div class="es-icon" style="color:#dc2626;"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i></div>
                        <h6>Error Loading Data</h6>
                        <p>Could not load subscription data. Please try refreshing the page.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        });
});

function initCheckboxes() {
    const selectAll = document.getElementById('selectAll');
    const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.customer-checkbox');
    const bulkBar = document.getElementById('bulk-action-bar');
    const countSpan = document.getElementById('selected-count');

    function updateBulkBar() {
        const checkedCount = document.querySelectorAll('.customer-checkbox:checked').length;
        countSpan.textContent = checkedCount;
        if (checkedCount > 0) {
            bulkBar.classList.remove('d-none');
        } else {
            bulkBar.classList.add('d-none');
            if(selectAll) selectAll.checked = false;
        }
    }

    if (selectAll) {
        selectAll.addEventListener('change', function() {
            checkboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = selectAll.checked);
            updateBulkBar();
        });
    }

    checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
        cb.addEventListener('change', updateBulkBar);
    });
}

function getSelectedIds() {
    return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.customer-checkbox:checked')).map(cb => parseInt(cb.value));
}

function sendBulkAction(type) {
    const ids = getSelectedIds();
    if (ids.length === 0) return;

    let payload = { customer_ids: ids };
    let endpoint = '';
    
    if (type === 'sms') {
        const msg = document.getElementById('bulkSmsMessage').value;
        if(!msg) return alert("Message cannot be empty.");
        payload.message = msg;
        endpoint = '/customers/bulk-sms/';
    } else {
        const sub = document.getElementById('bulkEmailSubject').value || 'Important Notice';
        const msg = document.getElementById('bulkEmailMessage').value;
        if(!msg) return alert("Message cannot be empty.");
        payload.subject = sub;
        payload.message = msg;
        endpoint = '/customers/bulk-email/';
    }

    fetch(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'X-CSRFToken': getCookie('csrftoken')
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    })
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(data => {
        if(data.success) {
            alert(`Successfully sent ${data.sent_count} messages!`);
            location.reload();
        } else {
            alert("Error: " + data.error);
        }
    })
    .catch(err => {
        alert("Network error occurred.");
    });
}

// CSRF helper
function getCookie(name) {
    let cookieValue = null;
    if (document.cookie && document.cookie !== '') {
        const cookies = document.cookie.split(';');
        for (let i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
            const cookie = cookies[i].trim();
            if (cookie.substring(0, name.length + 1) === (name + '=')) {
                cookieValue = decodeURIComponent(cookie.substring(name.length + 1));
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return cookieValue;
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

<!-- Base Partial: Scripts -->
<!-- Layout scripts (put at end for better performance) -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    const openSidebarBtn = document.getElementById('openSidebar');
    const closeSidebarBtn = document.getElementById('closeSidebar');
    const sidebarOverlay = document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay');
    const hideSidebarBtn = document.getElementById('hideSidebar');
    const mainContent = document.getElementById('mainContent');
    const showSidebarBtn = document.getElementById('showSidebar');

    // Restore state
    let collapsed = localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true';
    if (collapsed && window.innerWidth >= 992) {
        sidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
        if (mainContent) mainContent.classList.add('full');
        if (hideSidebarBtn) hideSidebarBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if (showSidebarBtn) showSidebarBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
    }

    function openSidebar() {
        sidebar.classList.add('open');
        sidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
        mainContent.classList.remove('full');
        if (window.innerWidth < 992) {
            sidebarOverlay.classList.add('active');
        }
        if (window.innerWidth >= 992) {
            if (showSidebarBtn) showSidebarBtn.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    function closeSidebar() {
        sidebar.classList.remove('open');
        sidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
        if (window.innerWidth < 992) {
            sidebarOverlay.classList.remove('active');
        } else {
            mainContent.classList.add('full');
        }
        if (window.innerWidth >= 992) {
            if (showSidebarBtn) showSidebarBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
        }
    }

    function hideSidebar() {
        if (window.innerWidth >= 992) {
            sidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
            sidebar.classList.remove('open');
            mainContent.classList.add('full');
            if (showSidebarBtn) showSidebarBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
            if (hideSidebarBtn) hideSidebarBtn.style.display = 'none';
            localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'true');
        }
    }

    function showSidebar() {
        if (window.innerWidth >= 992) {
            sidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
            mainContent.classList.remove('full');
            if (hideSidebarBtn) hideSidebarBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
            if (showSidebarBtn) showSidebarBtn.style.display = 'none';
            localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', 'false');
        }
    }

    if (openSidebarBtn) openSidebarBtn.addEventListener('click', openSidebar);
    if (closeSidebarBtn) closeSidebarBtn.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);
    if (sidebarOverlay) sidebarOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);
    if (hideSidebarBtn) hideSidebarBtn.addEventListener('click', hideSidebar);
    if (showSidebarBtn) showSidebarBtn.addEventListener('click', showSidebar);

    // Expand sidebar if dropdown clicked while collapsed
    const dropdownToggles = document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-toggle');
    dropdownToggles.forEach(toggle => {
        toggle.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                showSidebar();
            }
        });
    });
    });

    // =============================================
    // GAMER THEME TOGGLE — v2.0
    // =============================================
    const gtToggleBtn = document.getElementById('gt-theme-toggle');
    const themeIcon   = document.getElementById('themeIcon');
    const themeLabel  = document.getElementById('themeLabel');
    const gtScanline  = document.getElementById('gt-scanline');
    const htmlEl      = document.documentElement;

    // 8-bit click sound via Web Audio API
    function playGamerClick(isDark) {
        try {
            const ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            // Dark mode: low-pitched bwoop. Light mode: high-pitched ping.
            osc.type = 'square';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(isDark ? 180 : 880, ctx.currentTime);
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(isDark ? 80 : 440, ctx.currentTime + 0.12);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, ctx.currentTime);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
            osc.start(ctx.currentTime);
            osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
        } catch(e) { /* audio not supported, silently skip */ }
    }

    // Scanline flash animation
    function triggerScanline() {
        if (!gtScanline) return;
        gtScanline.classList.remove('flash');
        void gtScanline.offsetWidth; // reflow to restart animation
        gtScanline.classList.add('flash');
        gtScanline.addEventListener('animationend', () => gtScanline.classList.remove('flash'), { once: true });
    }

    function updateThemeUI() {
        const isDark = htmlEl.classList.contains('dark-mode');
        if (isDark) {
            themeIcon.className = 'fas fa-gamepad gt-toggle-icon';
            if (themeLabel) themeLabel.textContent = 'DARK';
        } else {
            themeIcon.className = 'fas fa-sun gt-toggle-icon';
            if (themeLabel) themeLabel.textContent = 'LIGHT';
        }
    }

    if (gtToggleBtn) {
        updateThemeUI();

        gtToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            triggerScanline();
            // Small delay so the scanline starts before the color swap
            setTimeout(() => {
                htmlEl.classList.toggle('dark-mode');
                const isDark = htmlEl.classList.contains('dark-mode');
                localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
                updateThemeUI();
                playGamerClick(isDark);
                // Dispatch so charts/live monitoring can re-render
                window.dispatchEvent(new Event('themeChanged'));
            }, 80);
        });
    }

    // Global DataTables Placeholder & Icon Injector
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        const observer = new MutationObserver(function() {
            // Safely remove text node from labels so the input stays visible
            document.querySelectorAll('.dataTables_filter label').forEach(label => {
                Array.from(label.childNodes).forEach(node => {
                    if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && node.textContent.trim() !== '') {
                        node.textContent = '';
                    }
                });
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('.dataTables_length label').forEach(label => {
                Array.from(label.childNodes).forEach(node => {
                    if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && node.textContent.trim() !== '') {
                        node.textContent = '';
                    }
                });
            });

            const dtInputs = document.querySelectorAll('.dataTables_filter input:not([placeholder])');
            dtInputs.forEach(input => {
                input.setAttribute('placeholder', 'Search records...');
                input.classList.add('dt-premium-search');
            });
            const dtSelects = document.querySelectorAll('.dataTables_length select:not(.dt-premium-select)');
            dtSelects.forEach(select => {
                select.classList.add('dt-premium-select');
                // Replace default text if possible
                Array.from(select.options).forEach(opt => {
                    if (!opt.text.includes('per page')) {
                        opt.text = opt.value + ' per page';
                    }
                });
            });
        });
        observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        
        // Convert Django Messages to Floating Toasts
        const toastContainer = document.createElement('div');
        toastContainer.id = 'toast-container';
        toastContainer.style.cssText = 'position: fixed; top: 20px; right: 20px; z-index: 9999; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; max-width: 450px;';
        document.body.appendChild(toastContainer);
        
        // Grab alerts that look like messages (usually have 'fa-check-circle' or are direct children of the main container)
        document.querySelectorAll('.content-wrapper .alert').forEach(alert => {
            // Avoid moving static alerts like form errors inside forms
            if(alert.closest('form')) return;
            
            toastContainer.appendChild(alert);
            alert.style.animation = 'slideInRight 0.3s ease-out forwards';
            alert.style.cursor = 'pointer';
            alert.title = "Click to dismiss";
            alert.style.boxShadow = '0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
            
            // Auto dismiss after 5 seconds
            setTimeout(() => {
                alert.style.opacity = '0';
                alert.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s';
                setTimeout(() => alert.remove(), 500);
            }, 5000);
            
            // Click to dismiss
            alert.addEventListener('click', () => alert.remove());
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    
    // Online staff JS
    function fetchOnlineStaff() {
        fetch('/api/online-staff/')
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(data => {
                if(data.status === 'success') {
                    const list = document.getElementById('onlineStaffList');
                    const badge = document.getElementById('onlineStaffBadge');
                    const colors = ['#059669','#2563eb','#7c3aed','#dc2626','#ea580c','#0891b2'];

                    if(data.data.length > 0) {
                        badge.style.display = 'inline-block';
                        badge.innerText = data.data.length;

                        let html = '<div class="p-2 d-flex flex-column gap-2">';
                        data.data.forEach((user, idx) => {
                            const color = colors[idx % colors.length];
                            const initial = user.username.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
                            const roleColor = user.role === 'Admin' ? '#dc2626' : user.role === 'CSR' ? '#2563eb' : '#059669';
                            html += `
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 p-2 rounded-3 gt-staff-row">
                                <div class="position-relative flex-shrink-0">
                                    <div class="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center rounded-circle text-white fw-bold" style="width:42px;height:42px;background:${color};font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:-1px;">
                                        ${initial}
                                    </div>
                                    <span class="position-absolute bottom-0 end-0 border border-2 border-white rounded-circle bg-success" style="width:12px;height:12px;"></span>
                                </div>
                                <div class="flex-grow-1 overflow-hidden">
                                    <div class="fw-bold gt-staff-name" style="font-size:0.88rem;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">${user.username}</div>
                                    <span class="badge rounded-pill" style="font-size:0.68rem;background:${roleColor}20;color:${roleColor};border:1px solid ${roleColor}40;">${user.role}</span>
                                </div>
                                <div class="text-end flex-shrink-0">
                                    <span class="badge rounded-pill gt-online-badge">
                                        <i class="fas fa-circle" style="font-size:0.5rem;"></i> Online
                                    </span>
                                </div>
                            </div>`;
                        });
                        html += '</div>';
                        list.innerHTML = html;
                    } else {
                        badge.style.display = 'none';
                        list.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="p-4 text-center gt-muted-text">
                            <div class="d-inline-flex align-items-center justify-content-center rounded-circle mb-2 gt-icon-circle">
                                <i class="fas fa-user-slash" style="font-size:1.2rem;"></i>
                            </div>
                            <div class="fw-semibold" style="font-size:0.85rem;">No one else is online</div>
                            <div style="font-size:0.75rem;opacity:0.7;">Only you are logged in right now</div>
                        </div>`;
                    }
                }
            })
            .catch(err => console.error(err));
    }

    // Re-render staff list when theme changes so colors update immediately
    window.addEventListener('themeChanged', () => {
        if(document.getElementById('onlineStaffBadge')?.style.display !== 'none') {
            fetchOnlineStaff();
        }
    });

    
    // Fetch once on load to show badge
    setTimeout(fetchOnlineStaff, 2000);
    // Poll every 5 seconds for a truly live list
    setInterval(fetchOnlineStaff, 5000);

    // Idle timeout: automatically log out after 5 minutes of inactivity
    let idleTimeout;
    function resetIdleTimeout() {
        clearTimeout(idleTimeout);
        idleTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            window.location.href = '/logout/';
        }, 5 * 60 * 1000); // 5 minutes
    }
    
    // Listen for any interaction to reset the timer
    ['mousemove', 'mousedown', 'keypress', 'touchmove', 'scroll'].forEach(evt => {
        document.addEventListener(evt, resetIdleTimeout, false);
    });
    resetIdleTimeout();
});
</script>

<script>
document.getElementById('submitImprovementBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
    const msg = document.getElementById('improvementMessage').value.trim();
    const errEl = document.getElementById('improvementError');
    const btn = this;

    if (!msg) {
        errEl.textContent = 'Please describe what you would like us to improve.';
        errEl.style.display = 'block';
        return;
    }
    errEl.style.display = 'none';
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin me-2"></i>Sending...';
    btn.disabled = true;

    fetch('/api/improvement-request/', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'X-CSRFToken': document.cookie.match(/csrftoken=([^;]+)/)?.[1] || ''
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ message: msg })
    })
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(data => {
        if (data.success) {
            const modal = bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('improvementModal'));
            modal.hide();
            document.getElementById('improvementMessage').value = '';
            
            // Show success toast using Gametech brand styling
            if (!document.getElementById('improvToast')) {
                const toastHTML = `
                <div id="improvToast" style="position:fixed;bottom:24px;right:24px;z-index:9999;min-width:300px;" class="toast show align-items-center text-white border-0 shadow-lg" role="alert" style="border-radius:16px;background:#0349cb;">
                    <div class="d-flex" style="background:#0349cb;border-radius:14px;">
                        <div class="toast-body d-flex align-items-center gap-3 py-3 px-4">
                            <div class="rounded-circle d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center" style="width:36px;height:36px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.2);">
                                <i class="fas fa-check"></i>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <strong class="d-block mb-1">Request Sent!</strong>
                                <span style="opacity:0.9;font-size:0.85rem;">The devs will look into it.</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white me-3 m-auto" data-bs-dismiss="toast" aria-label="Close"></button>
                    </div>
                </div>`;
                document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', toastHTML);
                setTimeout(() => { const t = document.getElementById('improvToast'); if(t) t.remove(); }, 4000);
            }
        } else {
            errEl.textContent = data.error || 'Something went wrong. Please try again.';
            errEl.style.display = 'block';
        }
    })
    .catch(() => {
        errEl.textContent = 'Network error. Please try again.';
        errEl.style.display = 'block';
    })
    .finally(() => {
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-paper-plane me-2"></i>Send Request';
        btn.disabled = false;
    });
});

// Hover effect on improvement button
const impBtn = document.getElementById('improvementBtn');
if (impBtn) {
    impBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => impBtn.style.transform = 'scale(1.05)');
    impBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => impBtn.style.transform = 'scale(1)');
}
</script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {
        var table = $('#customerTable').DataTable({
            "responsive": true,
            "dom": '<"d-flex flex-column flex-md-row justify-content-between align-items-center mt-4 mb-3 px-3 px-md-4"lf>rt<"d-flex flex-column flex-md-row justify-content-between align-items-center mt-3 mb-4 px-3 px-md-4"ip>',
            "lengthMenu": [10, 25, 50, 100, -1],
            "pageLength": 10,
            "order": [], // Use backend custom sorting
            "language": {
                "search": "",
                "searchPlaceholder": "Search customers..."
            },
            "columnDefs": [
                { "orderable": false, "targets": 0 }, // Disable sorting on Checkbox column
                { "orderable": false, "targets": 9 }  // Disable sorting on Actions column
            ]
        });

        $('#routerFilter').on('change', function () {
            table.column(7).search(this.value).draw();
        });

        $('#barangayFilter').on('change', function () {
            table.column(6).search(this.value).draw();
        });

        // --- Bulk SMS & Email Logic ---
        function updateSelectedCount() {
            var selectedCount = table.$('.customer-checkbox:checked').length;
            $('#selectedCount').text(selectedCount);
            $('#modalSelectedCount').text(selectedCount);
            $('#btnBulkSms').prop('disabled', selectedCount === 0);
            
            $('#selectedEmailCount').text(selectedCount);
            $('#modalSelectedEmailCount').text(selectedCount);
            $('#btnBulkEmail').prop('disabled', selectedCount === 0);
            
            var totalCount = table.$('.customer-checkbox').length;
            $('#selectAllCheckbox').prop('checked', selectedCount > 0 && selectedCount === totalCount);
            
            // Add Transfer Logic
            $('#selectedTransferCount').text(selectedCount);
            $('#transferCountDisplay').text(selectedCount);
            $('#btnBulkTransfer').prop('disabled', selectedCount === 0);
            $('#transferCustomerInputs').empty();
            table.$('.customer-checkbox:checked').each(function() {
                $('#transferCustomerInputs').append(`<input type="hidden" name="customer_ids" value="${$(this).val()}">`);
            });
        }

        $('#selectAllCheckbox').on('change', function() {
            var isChecked = $(this).prop('checked');
            // Only select the rows that are currently visible/filtered by the user's search
            table.$('.customer-checkbox', {"filter":"applied"}).prop('checked', isChecked);
            updateSelectedCount();
        });

        $('#customerTable tbody').on('change', '.customer-checkbox', function() {
            updateSelectedCount();
        });

        table.on('draw', function() {
            updateSelectedCount(); // re-eval when page/filter changes
        });

        $('#btnSendBulkSms').on('click', function() {
            var selectedIds = [];
            // We use table.$ to query all pages of the datatable, not just the visible page.
            table.$('.customer-checkbox:checked').each(function() {
                selectedIds.push($(this).val());
            });
            var message = $('#bulkSmsMessage').val();
            
            if (!message.trim()) {
                Swal.fire('Error', 'Please enter a message.', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            $(this).html('<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin me-2"></i> Sending...').prop('disabled', true);
            
            $.ajax({
                url: '{% url "bulk_sms_view" %}',
                type: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'X-CSRFToken': '{{ csrf_token }}'
                },
                contentType: 'application/json',
                data: JSON.stringify({
                    customer_ids: selectedIds,
                    message: message
                }),
                success: function(response) {
                    if (response.success) {
                        $('#bulkSmsModal').modal('hide');
                        $('#bulkSmsMessage').val('');
                        table.$('.customer-checkbox').prop('checked', false);
                        $('#selectAllCheckbox').prop('checked', false);
                        updateSelectedCount();
                        
                        Swal.fire({
                            title: 'Success!',
                            text: 'Successfully sent ' + response.sent_count + ' SMS messages.',
                            icon: 'success',
                            confirmButtonColor: '#10b981'
                        });
                    } else {
                        Swal.fire('Error', response.error || 'Unknown error occurred.', 'error');
                    }
                },
                error: function(err) {
                    Swal.fire('Error', 'A network error occurred.', 'error');
                },
                complete: function() {
                    $('#btnSendBulkSms').html('Send Now <i class="fas fa-paper-plane ms-2"></i>').prop('disabled', false);
                }
            });
        });

        $('#btnSendBulkEmail').on('click', function() {
            var selectedIds = [];
            table.$('.customer-checkbox:checked').each(function() {
                selectedIds.push($(this).val());
            });
            var subject = $('#bulkEmailSubject').val();
            var message = $('#bulkEmailMessage').val();
            
            if (!subject.trim() || !message.trim()) {
                Swal.fire('Error', 'Please enter a subject and a message.', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            $(this).html('<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin me-2"></i> Sending...').prop('disabled', true);
            
            $.ajax({
                url: '{% url "bulk_email_view" %}',
                type: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'X-CSRFToken': '{{ csrf_token }}'
                },
                contentType: 'application/json',
                data: JSON.stringify({
                    customer_ids: selectedIds,
                    subject: subject,
                    message: message
                }),
                success: function(response) {
                    if (response.success) {
                        $('#bulkEmailModal').modal('hide');
                        $('#bulkEmailSubject').val('');
                        $('#bulkEmailMessage').val('');
                        table.$('.customer-checkbox').prop('checked', false);
                        $('#selectAllCheckbox').prop('checked', false);
                        updateSelectedCount();
                        
                        Swal.fire({
                            title: 'Success!',
                            text: 'Successfully sent ' + response.sent_count + ' Email messages.',
                            icon: 'success',
                            confirmButtonColor: '#10b981'
                        });
                    } else {
                        Swal.fire('Error', response.error || 'Unknown error occurred.', 'error');
                    }
                },
                error: function(err) {
                    Swal.fire('Error', 'A network error occurred.', 'error');
                },
                complete: function() {
                    $('#btnSendBulkEmail').html('Send Now <i class="fas fa-paper-plane ms-2"></i>').prop('disabled', false);
                }
            });
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
    function showReason(btn) {
        let el = btn.closest('.conn-status-indicator');
        let status = el.getAttribute('data-status');
        let cid = el.getAttribute('data-customer-id');
        let reason = el.getAttribute('data-health-reason') || "No specific reason provided.";
        let health = el.getAttribute('data-health-status') || "Excellent";
        let balance = el.getAttribute('data-balance');
        
        let routerHealth = el.getAttribute('data-router-health');
        let routerName = el.getAttribute('data-router-name');
        let brgyHealth = el.getAttribute('data-barangay-health');
        let brgyName = el.getAttribute('data-barangay-name');
        let routerUnreachable = el.getAttribute('data-router-unreachable') === 'true';

        let effectiveReason = reason;
        let effectiveHealth = health;
        let canResolve = false; 
        let resolveScope = 'customer';
        let resolveId = cid;

        if (status === 'suspended') {
            Swal.fire({
                icon: 'warning',
                title: 'Account Suspended',
                html: `This account is currently suspended.<br><br><b>Advance Payment:</b> ₱${balance}`,
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonText: '<i class="fas fa-eye me-1"></i> View Profile',
                cancelButtonText: 'Close',
                confirmButtonColor: '#3085d6'
            }).then((result) => {
                if (result.isConfirmed) {
                    window.location.href = '/customers/view/' + cid + '/';
                }
            });
            return;
        }

        // Intelligent Diagnosis Logic
        if (health === 'Excellent' || !health) {
            if (routerUnreachable) {
                effectiveHealth = 'Router Uplink Offline';
                effectiveReason = `The main router (${routerName}) has lost its internet connection (Uplink Offline) or is completely unreachable from the server.`;
                canResolve = false; 
            } else if (routerHealth && routerHealth !== 'Excellent') {
                effectiveHealth = `${routerHealth} (Router Issue)`;
                effectiveReason = `The main router (${routerName}) is currently experiencing issues.`;
                resolveScope = 'router';
                resolveId = el.getAttribute('data-router-id');
                canResolve = true;
            } else if (brgyHealth && brgyHealth !== 'Excellent') {
                effectiveHealth = `${brgyHealth} (Barangay Issue)`;
                effectiveReason = `The area (${brgyName}) is currently experiencing an outage.`;
                resolveScope = 'barangay';
                resolveId = el.getAttribute('data-barangay-id');
                canResolve = true;
            } else {
                effectiveHealth = 'Isolated Offline';
                effectiveReason = 'Customer router is unplugged, fiber cable is cut, or there is a localized power outage.';
                canResolve = false; 
            }
        } else {
            canResolve = true; 
        }

        let swalOptions = {
            icon: canResolve ? 'warning' : 'error',
            title: 'Customer Offline Diagnosis',
            html: `<div class="text-start mt-3 p-3 bg-light rounded border">
                    <b>Network Health:</b> <span class="${canResolve ? 'text-warning' : 'text-danger'}">${effectiveHealth}</span><br>
                    <hr class="my-2">
                    <b>System Diagnosis:</b> <span class="text-muted">${effectiveReason}</span>
                   </div>`,
            showCancelButton: true,
            cancelButtonText: 'Close'
        };

        if (canResolve) {
            swalOptions.confirmButtonText = '<i class="fas fa-check me-1"></i> Resolve Status';
            swalOptions.confirmButtonColor = '#10b981';
        } else {
            swalOptions.showConfirmButton = false;
        }

        Swal.fire(swalOptions).then((result) => {
            if (result.isConfirmed && canResolve) {
                window.location.href = `/network/health/resolve/${resolveScope}/${resolveId}/`;
            }
        });
    }

    function updateConnectionStatuses() {
        let indicators = document.querySelectorAll('.conn-status-indicator');
        if (indicators.length === 0) return;
        
        Promise.all([
            fetch('/api/active-usernames/').then(res => res.json()),
            fetch('/api/router-uplink/').then(res => res.json())
        ])
        .then(([activeData, uplinkData]) => {
            if (activeData.status === 'success') {
                let active_users = new Set(activeData.active_usernames);
                let offline_routers = new Set(activeData.offline_routers || []);
                
                // Map router uplink statuses
                let router_uplinks = {};
                if (uplinkData.routers) {
                    uplinkData.routers.forEach(r => {
                        router_uplinks[r.id] = r.uplink_status;
                    });
                }
                
                indicators.forEach(el => {
                    let pppoe = el.getAttribute('data-pppoe');
                    let status = el.getAttribute('data-status');
                    let routerId = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-router-id'));
                    let btnHtml = '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-light p-0 ms-1 rounded-circle shadow-sm border" onclick="showReason(this)" title="View Reason" style="width: 22px; height: 22px; line-height: 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle text-danger" style="font-size: 0.8rem;"></i></button>';
                    
                    if (status === 'suspended') {
                        el.innerHTML = '<span class="badge bg-danger rounded-pill shadow-sm mt-1"><i class="fas fa-ban me-1"></i>Suspended</span>' + btnHtml;
                    } else if (!pppoe) {
                        el.innerHTML = '<span class="badge bg-secondary rounded-pill shadow-sm mt-1"><i class="fas fa-question-circle me-1"></i>No PPPoE</span>';
                    } else if (active_users.has(pppoe)) {
                        el.innerHTML = '<span class="badge bg-success rounded-pill shadow-sm mt-1" style="background-color: #10b981 !important;"><i class="fas fa-check-circle me-1"></i>Active</span>';
                    } else {
                        let isRouterOffline = false;
                        if (!isNaN(routerId)) {
                            // Offline if API connection completely failed
                            if (offline_routers.has(routerId)) isRouterOffline = true;
                            // OR offline if router is connected but has no internet (uplink offline)
                            if (router_uplinks[routerId] === 'Offline') isRouterOffline = true;
                        }

                        if (isRouterOffline) {
                            el.setAttribute('data-router-unreachable', 'true');
                        }
                        el.innerHTML = '<span class="badge rounded-pill shadow-sm mt-1" style="background-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1); color: #ef4444; border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3);"><i class="fas fa-wifi me-1" style="text-decoration: line-through;"></i>Offline</span>' + btnHtml;
                    }
                });
            }
        })
        .catch(err => console.error("Error fetching connection statuses", err));
    }
    
    // Run immediately, then every 30 seconds
    updateConnectionStatuses();
    setInterval(updateConnectionStatuses, 30000);
    
    // Also run when DataTables redraws the page
    $('#customerTable').on('draw.dt', function () {
        updateConnectionStatuses();
    });
</script>
