--- FILE: .\billing\templates\billing\dashboard\_scripts.html ---
{% load static %}
<!-- Dashboard Partial: All Dashboard JavaScript -->
<script>
  let revenueChart, planChart, dashboardChart;

  function applyChartTheme() {
    const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark-mode');
    Chart.defaults.color = isDark ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b';
    Chart.defaults.scale.grid.color = isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)';
    
    if (typeof dashboardChart !== 'undefined' && dashboardChart) {
      const dsCtx = document.getElementById('dashboardSalesChart').getContext('2d');
      let grad = dsCtx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 350);
      if (isDark) {
        grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(251, 174, 26, 0.4)');
        grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(251, 174, 26, 0.02)');
        dashboardChart.data.datasets[0].borderColor = '#fbae1a';
        dashboardChart.data.datasets[0].pointBorderColor = '#fbae1a';
      } else {
        grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(33, 81, 161, 0.4)');
        grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(33, 81, 161, 0.02)');
        dashboardChart.data.datasets[0].borderColor = '#2151A1';
        dashboardChart.data.datasets[0].pointBorderColor = '#2151A1';
      }
      dashboardChart.data.datasets[0].backgroundColor = grad;
      dashboardChart.update();
    }
    return isDark;
  }
  window.addEventListener('themeChanged', applyChartTheme);
  Chart.defaults.font.family = "'Outfit', sans-serif";
  
  // Register datalabels plugin globally but disable it by default
  Chart.register(ChartDataLabels);
  Chart.defaults.plugins.datalabels.display = false;

  applyChartTheme();

  const months = {{ months_js|safe|default:"[]" }};
  const salesByMonth = {{ sales_by_month_js|safe|default:"[]" }};
  const days = {{ days_js|safe|default:"[]" }};
  const salesByDay = {{ sales_by_day_js|safe|default:"[]" }};
  const pieLabels = {{ pie_labels_js|safe|default:"[]" }};
  const pieData = {{ pie_data_js|safe|default:"[]" }};



  // Dashboard Sales Overview Chart
  const dsCtx = document.getElementById('dashboardSalesChart');
  if (dsCtx) {
    const isDarkInit = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark-mode');
    let initGrad = dsCtx.getContext('2d').createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 350);
    if (isDarkInit) {
      initGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(251, 174, 26, 0.4)');
      initGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(251, 174, 26, 0.02)');
    } else {
      initGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(33, 81, 161, 0.4)');
      initGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(33, 81, 161, 0.02)');
    }

    dashboardChart = new Chart(dsCtx.getContext('2d'), {
      type: 'line',
      data: {
        labels: days,
        datasets: [{
          data: salesByDay,
          fill: true,
          backgroundColor: initGrad,
          borderColor: isDarkInit ? '#fbae1a' : '#2151A1',
          borderWidth: 3,
          tension: 0.4,
          pointBackgroundColor: '#ffffff',
          pointBorderColor: isDarkInit ? '#fbae1a' : '#2151A1',
          pointBorderWidth: 2,
          pointRadius: 5,
          pointHoverRadius: 7
        }]
      },
      options: {
        responsive: true,
        maintainAspectRatio: false,
        plugins: {
          legend: { display: false },
          tooltip: {
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9)',
            titleFont: { size: 14, family: 'Outfit' },
            bodyFont: { size: 14, family: 'Outfit' },
            padding: 12,
            cornerRadius: 12,
            displayColors: false,
            callbacks: { label: function (c) { return '₱ ' + c.parsed.y.toLocaleString(); } }
          },
          datalabels: {
            display: true,
            color: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark-mode') ? '#e2e8f0' : '#1e293b',
            font: { family: 'Outfit', weight: 'bold', size: 12 },
            align: 'top',
            offset: 8,
            formatter: function(value) {
              if (value >= 1000) {
                return (value / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'k';
              }
              return value;
            }
          }
        },
        scales: {
          y: { 
            beginAtZero: true, 
            border: { display: false },
            grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)', borderDash: [5, 5] },
            ticks: { font: { family: 'Outfit' } }
          },
          x: { 
            border: { display: false }, 
            grid: { display: false },
            ticks: { font: { family: 'Outfit' } }
          }
        },
        interaction: { intersect: false, mode: 'index' }
      }
    });

    // Toggle Filter Logic
    document.querySelectorAll('.sales-toggle').forEach(radio => {
      radio.addEventListener('change', function () {
        if (this.value === '7d') {
          dashboardChart.data.labels = days;
          dashboardChart.data.datasets[0].data = salesByDay;
        } else {
          dashboardChart.data.labels = months;
          dashboardChart.data.datasets[0].data = salesByMonth;
        }
        dashboardChart.update();
      });
    });
  }

  const revenueModalEl = document.getElementById('revenueModal');
  if (revenueModalEl) {
    revenueModalEl.addEventListener('shown.bs.modal', function () {

      const ctx = document.getElementById('revenueMainChart');
      if (ctx && !revenueChart) {
        let gradBlue = ctx.getContext('2d').createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 400);
        gradBlue.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.8)');
        gradBlue.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1)');

        let gradGreen = ctx.getContext('2d').createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 400);
        gradGreen.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.8)');
        gradGreen.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1)');

        revenueChart = new Chart(ctx.getContext('2d'), {
          type: 'line',
          data: {
            labels: months,
            datasets: [{
              label: 'Revenue',
              data: salesByMonth,
              fill: true,
              backgroundColor: gradBlue,
              borderColor: '#3b82f6',
              borderWidth: 3,
              tension: 0.4,
              pointBackgroundColor: '#ffffff',
              pointBorderColor: '#3b82f6',
              pointBorderWidth: 2,
              pointRadius: 4,
              pointHoverRadius: 6
            }]
          },
          options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: {
              legend: { display: false },
              tooltip: {
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9)',
                titleFont: { size: 14, family: 'Outfit' },
                bodyFont: { size: 14, family: 'Outfit' },
                padding: 12,
                cornerRadius: 12,
                displayColors: false,
                callbacks: { label: function (c) { return '₱ ' + c.parsed.y.toLocaleString(); } }
              }
            },
            scales: {
              y: { beginAtZero: true, border: { display: false } },
              x: { border: { display: false }, grid: { display: false } }
            },
            interaction: { intersect: false, mode: 'index' }
          }
        });

        // Filter Logic
        document.getElementById('btnrev12m').addEventListener('change', function () {
          if (this.checked) {
            document.getElementById('revenueChartTitle').innerText = 'Revenue (Last 12 Months)';
            revenueChart.data.labels = months;
            revenueChart.data.datasets[0].data = salesByMonth;
            revenueChart.data.datasets[0].backgroundColor = gradBlue;
            revenueChart.data.datasets[0].borderColor = '#3b82f6';
            revenueChart.data.datasets[0].pointBorderColor = '#3b82f6';
            revenueChart.update();
          }
        });

        document.getElementById('btnrev7d').addEventListener('change', function () {
          if (this.checked) {
            document.getElementById('revenueChartTitle').innerText = 'Revenue (Last 7 Days)';
            revenueChart.data.labels = days;
            revenueChart.data.datasets[0].data = salesByDay;
            revenueChart.data.datasets[0].backgroundColor = gradGreen;
            revenueChart.data.datasets[0].borderColor = '#10b981';
            revenueChart.data.datasets[0].pointBorderColor = '#10b981';
            revenueChart.update();
          }
        });
      }
    });
  }

  // Handle Popular Plans filter changes
  document.querySelectorAll('.popular-plans-filter').forEach(radio => {
    radio.addEventListener('change', function() {
      loadPopularPlans(this.value);
    });
  });

  const popularPlansModalEl = document.getElementById('popularPlansModal');
  if (popularPlansModalEl) {
    popularPlansModalEl.addEventListener('show.bs.modal', function () {
      document.getElementById('ppMonth').checked = true;
      loadPopularPlans('month');
    });
  }

  // Handle revenue period toggle in main chart.js
  const radialCenterTextPlugin = {
    id: 'radialCenterText',
    beforeDraw(chart) {
      if (chart.config.options.elements && chart.config.options.elements.center) {
        const ctx = chart.ctx;
        const centerConfig = chart.config.options.elements.center;
        
        ctx.save();
        const centerX = (chart.chartArea.left + chart.chartArea.right) / 2;
        const centerY = (chart.chartArea.top + chart.chartArea.bottom) / 2;

        const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark-mode');

        // Draw Title
        ctx.font = 'bold 36px Poppins, sans-serif';
        ctx.fillStyle = isDark ? '#ffffff' : '#1e293b';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.fillText(centerConfig.title || '', centerX, centerY - 10);

        // Draw Subtitle
        ctx.font = '500 12px Montserrat, sans-serif';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
        ctx.fillText(centerConfig.subtitle || '', centerX, centerY + 25);
        
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }
  };
  Chart.register(radialCenterTextPlugin);

  let collectionChart;
  const collectionModalEl = document.getElementById('collectionModal');
  if (collectionModalEl) {
    collectionModalEl.addEventListener('shown.bs.modal', function () {
      const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark-mode');
      const emptyColor = isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)';
      // Monochromatic sleek blues for Payment Method
      const sleekBlues = ['#2563eb', '#3b82f6', '#60a5fa', '#93c5fd', '#bfdbfe']; 

      // 1. Overall Collection Rate Chart
      const rateCtx = document.getElementById('collectionRateChart');
      if (rateCtx && !collectionChart) {
        const rateDataEl = document.getElementById('collectionRateData');
        const rateVal = parseFloat(rateDataEl.getAttribute('data-rate'));
        const subTxt = rateDataEl.getAttribute('data-subtitle');
        
        collectionChart = new Chart(rateCtx.getContext('2d'), {
          type: 'doughnut',
          data: {
            labels: ['Collected', 'Pending'],
            datasets: [{
              data: [rateVal, 100 - rateVal],
              backgroundColor: ['#2563eb', emptyColor],
              borderWidth: 0,
              borderRadius: [10, 0] // Rounded edges for the filled part
            }]
          },
          options: {
            responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, cutout: '80%',
            plugins: {
              legend: { display: false },
              tooltip: { enabled: false }
            },
            elements: {
              center: { title: rateVal + '%', subtitle: subTxt }
            }
          }
        });
      }

      // 2. By Payment Method Chart (salesPieChart)
      const pieCtx = document.getElementById('salesPieChart');
      if (pieCtx && pieLabels.length > 0 && !planChart) {
        const pmDataEl = document.getElementById('paymentMethodData');
        const subTxt = pmDataEl.getAttribute('data-subtitle');
        
        // Use total transactions or simply the count of labels
        const total = pieData.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

        planChart = new Chart(pieCtx.getContext('2d'), {
          type: 'doughnut',
          data: {
            labels: pieLabels,
            datasets: [{
              data: pieData,
              backgroundColor: sleekBlues,
              borderWidth: isDark ? 2 : 2,
              borderColor: isDark ? '#1a1d24' : '#ffffff',
              hoverOffset: 4
            }]
          },
          options: {
            responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, cutout: '80%',
            plugins: {
              legend: { position: 'right', labels: { usePointStyle: true, padding: 15, font: { family: 'Poppins', size: 11 }, color: isDark ? '#cbd5e1' : '#475569' } }
            },
            elements: {
              center: { title: total.toString(), subtitle: subTxt }
            }
          }
        });
      }
    });
  }

  // Countdowns
  function updateCountdowns() {
    const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    document.querySelectorAll('.countdown').forEach(el => {
      const expire = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-expire'), 10);
      if (!isNaN(expire)) {
        const diff = expire - now;
        if (diff > 0) {
          const d = Math.floor(diff / 86400);
          const h = Math.floor((diff % 86400) / 3600);
          if (d > 0) {
            el.textContent = d + 'd ' + h + 'h';
          } else {
            const m = Math.floor((diff % 3600) / 60);
            el.textContent = h + 'h ' + m + 'm';
          }
        } else { el.textContent = 'Expired'; }
      }
    });
  }
  setInterval(updateCountdowns, 1000); updateCountdowns();

  // Digital Clock (Manila)
  function updateDigitalClock() {
    const now = new Date();
    const utc = now.getTime() + (now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000);
    const manila = new Date(utc + (3600000 * 8));
    const pad = n => n < 10 ? '0' + n : n;
    const clockEl = document.getElementById('live-clock-square');
    if (clockEl) {
      const date = manila.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
      clockEl.textContent = `${date} ${pad(manila.getHours())}:${pad(manila.getMinutes())}:${pad(manila.getSeconds())}`;
    }
  }
  setInterval(updateDigitalClock, 1000); updateDigitalClock();

  // Dashboard-specific Sidebar Logo Swap
  const sidebarLogo = document.querySelector('.sidebar-header img');
  if (sidebarLogo) {
    function updateSidebarLogo() {
      sidebarLogo.src = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark-mode')
        ? "{% static 'assets/images/logo_white.png' %}"
        : "{% static 'assets/images/logo_black.png' %}";
    }
    updateSidebarLogo();
    new MutationObserver(updateSidebarLogo).observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
  }

  // System Health Widget
  function fetchSystemHealth() {
    fetch("{% url 'api_downdetector_data' %}")
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(data => {
        const container = document.getElementById('system-health-widget-content');
        if(!container) return;
        
        if(!data.services || data.services.length === 0) {
            container.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted w-100 text-center d-block py-2">No services monitored.</span>';
            return;
        }
        
        container.innerHTML = '';
        data.services.forEach(s => {
            let bgColor = '#10b981'; // Up
            let icon = 'fa-check-circle';
            let textColor = '#ffffff';
            
            if(s.status === 'Degraded') {
                bgColor = '#f59e0b';
                icon = 'fa-exclamation-triangle';
                textColor = '#000000';
            } else if(s.status === 'Down') {
                bgColor = '#ef4444';
                icon = 'fa-times-circle';
            }
            
            const badge = document.createElement('div');
            badge.className = 'd-flex align-items-center justify-content-between p-2 px-3 rounded shadow-sm';
            badge.style.backgroundColor = bgColor;
            badge.style.color = textColor;
            badge.style.flex = '1 1 calc(25% - 0.5rem)';
            badge.style.minWidth = '200px';
            
            badge.innerHTML = `
                <div class="fw-bold" style="font-size: 0.9rem;">${s.name}</div>
                <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2">
                    <span style="font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600;"><i class="fas ${icon} me-1"></i>${s.status}</span>
                    <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; opacity: 0.8;">${s.latency_ms !== null ? s.latency_ms + 'ms' : '--'}</span>
                </div>
            `;
            container.appendChild(badge);
        });
      })
      .catch(err => console.error("Error fetching system health:", err));
  }
  
  fetchSystemHealth();
  setInterval(fetchSystemHealth, 30000);

  // Fetch Top Clients for Modal
  function loadTopClients(filterType) {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('topClientsTbody');
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="3" class="text-center py-5 text-muted"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin me-2"></i> Loading data...</td></tr>';
    
    fetch(`/api/top-clients/?filter=${filterType}`)
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => {
        if (data.status === 'success') {
          tbody.innerHTML = '';
          if (data.data.length === 0) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="3" class="text-center py-5 text-muted">No revenue data found for this period.</td></tr>';
            return;
          }
          data.data.forEach((client, index) => {
            const html = `
              <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.04);">
                <td class="ps-3 py-3">
                  <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3">
                    <div class="table-rank" style="width: 20px;">#${index + 1}</div>
                    <div class="fw-semibold text-dark table-text-dark">${client.username}</div>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td class="py-3 text-muted" style="font-size: 0.85rem;">${client.plan_name}</td>
                <td class="text-end pe-3 py-3 fw-bold table-value" style="color: #2151A1;">₱${client.total_paid.toLocaleString(undefined, {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2})}</td>
              </tr>
            `;
            tbody.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
          });
        }
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('Error fetching top clients:', err);
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="3" class="text-center py-5 text-danger">Error loading data.</td></tr>';
      });
  }

  // Fetch Popular Plans for Modal
  function loadPopularPlans(filterType) {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('popularPlansTbody');
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="2" class="text-center py-5 text-muted"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin me-2"></i> Loading data...</td></tr>';
    
    fetch(`/api/popular-plans/?filter=${filterType}`)
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => {
        if (data.status === 'success') {
          tbody.innerHTML = '';
          if (data.data.length === 0) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="2" class="text-center py-5 text-muted">No popular plans data found for this period.</td></tr>';
            return;
          }
          data.data.forEach((plan, index) => {
            const html = `
              <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.04);">
                <td class="ps-3 py-4 d-flex align-items-center gap-3">
                  <span class="table-rank">#${index + 1}</span>
                  <span class="fw-semibold text-dark table-text-dark">${plan.plan_name}</span>
                </td>
                <td class="text-end pe-3 py-4 fw-bold table-value" style="color: #2151A1;">${plan.cnt}</td>
              </tr>
            `;
            tbody.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
          });
        }
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('Error fetching popular plans:', err);
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="2" class="text-center py-5 text-danger">Error loading data.</td></tr>';
      });
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.top-clients-filter').forEach(radio => {
    radio.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
      loadTopClients(e.target.value);
    });
  });

  const topClientsModal = document.getElementById('topClientsModal');
  if (topClientsModal) {
    topClientsModal.addEventListener('show.bs.modal', () => {
      // Load default checked filter (month)
      const activeFilter = document.querySelector('.top-clients-filter:checked').value;
      loadTopClients(activeFilter);
    });
  }
</script>

    let allData = [];

    function openViewAllModal(type) {
        let title = document.getElementById('viewAllModalTitle');
        let body = document.getElementById('viewAllModalBody');
        let html = '<div class="table-responsive"><table class="table table-hover align-middle mb-0"><thead class="table-light">';

        if (type === 'network') {
            title.innerText = 'All Network Alerts';
            html += '<tr><th class="ps-3">Name</th><th>Type</th><th>Status</th><th>Reason</th><th class="pe-3 text-end">Action</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
            currentNetworkAlerts.forEach(a => {
                let btnColor = 'btn-danger';
                html += `<tr>
                    <td class="ps-3"><span class="fw-bold">${a.name}</span></td>
                    <td><span class="badge bg-secondary">${a.type.toUpperCase()}</span></td>
                    <td><span class="fw-semibold text-danger">${a.status}</span></td>
                    <td class="text-muted small" style="max-width: 200px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">${a.reason || '-'}</td>
                    <td class="pe-3 text-end"><a href="${a.type === 'customer' ? '/customers/view/' + a.id + '/' : '/network/health/resolve/' + a.type + '/' + a.id + '/'}" class="btn ${btnColor} rounded-circle d-inline-flex justify-content-center align-items-center" style="width: 26px; height: 26px; padding: 0; font-size: 0.75rem;" title="Resolve"><i class="fas fa-eye"></i></a></td>
                </tr>`;
            });
        } else if (type === 'addons') {
            title.innerText = 'All Pending Add-on Requests';
            html += '<tr><th class="ps-3">Customer</th><th>Add-on Type</th><th>Requested At</th><th class="pe-3 text-end">Action</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
            currentAddonRequests.forEach(req => {
                html += `<tr>
                    <td class="ps-3"><span class="fw-bold">${req.customer_name}</span></td>
                    <td><span class="badge bg-warning text-dark">${req.addon_type}</span></td>
                    <td class="text-muted small">${req.requested_at}</td>
                    <td class="pe-3 text-end"><a href="/customers/view/${req.customer_id}/" class="btn btn-warning rounded-circle d-inline-flex justify-content-center align-items-center" style="width: 26px; height: 26px; padding: 0; font-size: 0.75rem;" title="Process"><i class="fas fa-eye"></i></a></td>
                </tr>`;
            });
        } else if (type === 'offline') {
            title.innerText = 'All Paid Offline Customers';
            html += '<tr><th class="ps-3">Customer</th><th>Username</th><th>Down Since</th><th class="pe-3 text-end">Action</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
            currentOfflineUsers.forEach(u => {
                html += `<tr>
                    <td class="ps-3"><span class="fw-bold">${u.full_name}</span></td>
                    <td><span class="badge bg-primary">${u.username}</span></td>
                    <td class="text-muted small">${u.last_logged_out}</td>
                    <td class="pe-3 text-end"><a href="/customers/view/${u.id}/" class="btn btn-primary rounded-circle d-inline-flex justify-content-center align-items-center" style="width: 26px; height: 26px; padding: 0; font-size: 0.75rem;" title="View"><i class="fas fa-eye"></i></a></td>
                </tr>`;
            });
        } else if (type === 'hardware') {
            title.innerText = 'Hardware Telemetry';
            html += '<tr><th class="ps-3">Device Name</th><th>Status</th><th>CPU</th><th>RAM</th><th>Disk</th><th class="pe-3">Uptime</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
            currentHardwareData.forEach(h => {
                let badgeClass = h.status === 'Online' ? 'bg-success' : 'bg-danger';
                html += `<tr>
                    <td class="ps-3"><span class="fw-bold">${h.name}</span></td>
                    <td><span class="badge ${badgeClass}">${h.status}</span></td>
                    <td><span class="fw-semibold text-info">${h.cpu}</span></td>
                    <td><span class="fw-semibold text-warning">${h.ram}</span></td>
                    <td><span class="fw-semibold text-danger">${h.disk}</span></td>
                    <td class="pe-3 text-muted small">${h.uptime}</td>
                </tr>`;
            });
        }

        if ((type === 'network' && currentNetworkAlerts.length === 0) ||
            (type === 'addons' && currentAddonRequests.length === 0) ||
            (type === 'offline' && currentOfflineUsers.length === 0) ||
            (type === 'hardware' && currentHardwareData.length === 0)) {
            html = '<div class="text-center text-muted p-5">No data to display. <i class="fas fa-check-circle text-success ms-1"></i></div>';
        } else {
            html += '</tbody></table></div>';
        }

        body.innerHTML = html;
        $('#viewAllModal').modal('show');
    }

    function renderOfflineCustomers(offline_users) {
        currentOfflineUsers = offline_users || [];
        let tbody = document.getElementById('offlineUsersList');
        let badge = document.getElementById('offline-badge');
        if (!offline_users || offline_users.length === 0) {
            if (badge) badge.style.display = 'none';
            tbody.innerHTML = '<div class="text-muted small text-center mt-4">All Paid Customers are Online <i class="fas fa-check-circle text-success ms-1"></i></div>';
            return;
        }

        if (badge) {
            badge.style.display = 'inline-block';
            badge.innerText = offline_users.length + ' Offline';
        }

        let html = '';
        offline_users.forEach(u => {
            html += `
        <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center p-1 px-2 mb-1 border rounded bg-primary-subtle">
            <div class="d-flex align-items-center">
                <i class="fas fa-user-slash text-primary me-2 fs-6"></i>
                <div>
                    <h6 class="mb-0 text-primary fw-bold" style="font-size: 0.85rem;">${u.full_name} <span class="badge bg-primary ms-1">${u.username}</span></h6>
                    <p class="mb-0 text-primary-emphasis small" style="font-size: 0.7rem;"><i class="fas fa-clock me-1"></i>Down since: ${u.last_logged_out}</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <a href="/customers/view/${u.id}/" class="btn btn-primary rounded-circle d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center me-1" style="width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0; font-size: 0.65rem;" title="View" data-bs-toggle="tooltip"><i class="fas fa-eye"></i></a>
        </div>`;
        });
        tbody.innerHTML = html;
    }



    function loadAddonRequests() {
        fetch("{% url 'live_addon_requests_api' %}")
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(d => {
                currentAddonRequests = d.data || [];
                let list = document.getElementById('addon-requests-list');
                let badge = document.getElementById('addon-badge');
                if (d.data && d.data.length > 0) {
                    badge.style.display = 'inline-block';
                    badge.innerText = d.data.length + ' New';
                    let html = '';
                    d.data.forEach(req => {
                        html += `
                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center p-1 px-2 mb-1 border rounded bg-warning-subtle">
                    <div class="d-flex align-items-center">
                        <i class="fas fa-tv text-warning me-2 fs-6"></i>
                        <div>
                            <h6 class="mb-0 text-warning fw-bold" style="font-size: 0.85rem;">${req.addon_type}</h6>
                            <p class="mb-0 fw-semibold text-body" style="font-size: 0.75rem;">${req.customer_name}</p>
                            <p class="mb-0 text-warning-emphasis small" style="font-size: 0.7rem;"><i class="fas fa-clock me-1"></i>${req.requested_at}</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="d-flex gap-1">
                        <a href="/customers/view/${req.customer_id}/" class="btn btn-warning rounded-circle d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center me-1" style="width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0; font-size: 0.65rem;" title="View Profile" data-bs-toggle="tooltip"><i class="fas fa-eye"></i></a>
                        <button type="button" class="btn btn-success rounded-circle d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center" style="width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0; font-size: 0.65rem;" title="Apply Add-on" onclick="openApplyAddonModal(${req.id}, ${req.customer_id}, '${req.customer_name}', '${req.addon_type}')"><i class="fas fa-check"></i></button>
                    </div>
                </div>
                `;
                    });
                    list.innerHTML = html;
                } else {
                    badge.style.display = 'none';
                    list.innerHTML = '<div class="text-muted small text-center mt-3">No pending requests <i class="fas fa-check-circle text-success ms-1"></i></div>';
                }
            });
    }

    function loadNetworkAlerts() {
        fetch("{% url 'api_network_alerts' %}")
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(d => {
                currentNetworkAlerts = d.alerts || [];
                let list = document.getElementById('network-alerts-list');
                let badge = document.getElementById('network-badge');
                if (d.alerts && d.alerts.length > 0) {
                    if (badge) {
                        badge.style.display = 'inline-block';
                        badge.innerText = d.alerts.length + ' New';
                    }
                    let inner = '';
                    d.alerts.forEach(a => {
                        let icon = a.type === 'device' ? 'fa-server' : (a.type === 'barangay' ? 'fa-map-marker-alt' : 'fa-user-times');
                        let btnColor = 'btn-danger';
                        let subClass = 'bg-danger-subtle';
                        let textColor = 'text-danger';
                        let pulseClass = a.type === 'customer' ? 'alert-pulse-danger' : '';

                        inner += `
                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center p-1 px-2 mb-1 border border-danger rounded ${subClass} ${pulseClass}">
                    <div class="d-flex align-items-center">
                        <i class="fas ${icon} ${textColor} me-2 fs-6"></i>
                        <div>
                            <h6 class="mb-0 ${textColor} fw-bold" style="font-size: 0.85rem;">${a.name}</h6>
                            <p class="mb-0 fw-semibold text-body" style="font-size: 0.75rem;">${a.status}</p>
                            ${a.reason ? `<p class="mb-0 text-muted small" style="max-width: 150px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; font-size: 0.7rem;">${a.reason}</p>` : ''}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <a href="${a.type === 'customer' ? '/customers/view/' + a.id + '/' : '/network/health/resolve/' + a.type + '/' + a.id + '/'}" class="btn ${btnColor} rounded-circle d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center me-1" style="width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0; font-size: 0.65rem;" title="Resolve" data-bs-toggle="tooltip"><i class="fas fa-eye"></i></a>
                </div>
                `;
                    });
                    list.innerHTML = inner;
                } else {
                    if (badge) badge.style.display = 'none';
                    list.innerHTML = '<div class="text-muted small text-center mt-3">No active alerts <i class="fas fa-check-circle text-success ms-1"></i></div>';
                }
            });
    }

    let bandwidthChart = null;
    let chartLabels = Array(20).fill('');
    let rxChartData = Array(20).fill(0);
    let txChartData = Array(20).fill(0);

    function initChart() {
        const ctx = document.getElementById('bandwidthChart');
        if (!ctx) return;
        bandwidthChart = new Chart(ctx.getContext('2d'), {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
                labels: chartLabels,
                datasets: [
                    {
                        label: 'Download (Mbps)',
                        data: rxChartData,
                        borderColor: '#38bdf8',
                        backgroundColor: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2)',
                        borderWidth: 2,
                        fill: true,
                        tension: 0.4,
                        pointRadius: 0
                    },
                    {
                        label: 'Upload (Mbps)',
                        data: txChartData,
                        borderColor: '#10b981',
                        backgroundColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)',
                        borderWidth: 2,
                        fill: true,
                        tension: 0.4,
                        pointRadius: 0
                    }
                ]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                maintainAspectRatio: false,
                plugins: {
                    legend: { display: false },
                    tooltip: { enabled: false }
                },
                scales: {
                    x: { display: false },
                    y: {
                        display: true,
                        position: 'right',
                        ticks: { color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)', font: { size: 10 }, maxTicksLimit: 4 },
                        grid: { color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)' },
                        beginAtZero: true
                    }
                },
                animation: { duration: 0 }
            }
        });
    }

    function initCustomerChart() {
        const ctx = document.getElementById('customerSpecificChart');
        if (!ctx) return;
        customerChartObj = new Chart(ctx.getContext('2d'), {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
                labels: Array(20).fill(''),
                datasets: [
                    {
                        label: 'Download',
                        data: custRxData,
                        borderColor: '#38bdf8',
                        backgroundColor: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2)',
                        borderWidth: 2,
                        fill: true,
                        tension: 0.4,
                        pointRadius: 0
                    },
                    {
                        label: 'Upload',
                        data: custTxData,
                        borderColor: '#10b981',
                        backgroundColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)',
                        borderWidth: 2,
                        fill: true,
                        tension: 0.4,
                        pointRadius: 0
                    }
                ]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                maintainAspectRatio: false,
                plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { enabled: false } },
                scales: { 
                    x: { display: false }, 
                    y: { 
                        display: true, 
                        position: 'right',
                        ticks: { color: 'rgba(100,116,139,0.8)', font: { size: 10 }, maxTicksLimit: 4 }
                    } 
                },
                animation: { duration: 0 }
            }
        });
    }

    function openCustomerLiveChart(username) {
        modalCustomer = username;
        document.getElementById('modalCustomerTitle').innerText = username;
        
        // Reset chart data
        custRxData.fill(0);
        custTxData.fill(0);
        if (customerChartObj) customerChartObj.update();
        document.getElementById('modalRxText').innerText = "0.0";
        document.getElementById('modalTxText').innerText = "0.0";
        
        var myModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('customerLiveChartModal'));
        myModal.show();
    }

    function updateSummary() {
        let rx = allData.reduce((s, u) => s + +u.rx_mbps, 0);
        let tx = allData.reduce((s, u) => s + +u.tx_mbps, 0);
        let totalBw = rx + tx;
        document.getElementById('kpi-dl').innerHTML = `${rx.toFixed(1)} <span class="text-muted small">Mbps</span>`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-ul').innerHTML = `${tx.toFixed(1)} <span class="text-muted small">Mbps</span>`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-bw').innerHTML = `${totalBw.toFixed(1)} <span class="text-muted small">Mbps</span>`;
        document.getElementById('kpi-users').innerText = allData.length;

        let topUser = 'Jane Doe';
        if (allData.length > 0) {
            let sorted = [...allData].sort((a, b) => (b.rx_mbps + b.tx_mbps) - (a.rx_mbps + a.tx_mbps));
            topUser = sorted[0].user;
        }
        document.getElementById('kpi-top-user').innerText = topUser;

        // Update Chart
        rxChartData.shift(); rxChartData.push(rx);
        txChartData.shift(); txChartData.push(tx);
        if (bandwidthChart) bandwidthChart.update();
    }

    function applyFilter() {
        // DataTables handles its own filtering now, but we need to populate the rows.
        if (!liveTrafficTable) return;

        // Sort array descending by total bandwidth before adding to table
        let sorted = [...allData].sort((a, b) => (b.rx_mbps + b.tx_mbps) - (a.rx_mbps + a.tx_mbps));

        let rows = [];
        sorted.forEach(u => {
            let rxPct = maxRx > 0 ? (u.rx_mbps / maxRx) * 100 : 0;
            let txPct = maxTx > 0 ? (u.tx_mbps / maxTx) * 100 : 0;
            let totalBw = u.rx_mbps + u.tx_mbps;

            rows.push([
                `<div class="fw-bold text-body" style="font-size:1.0rem;">${u.user}</div>
             <div class="small text-muted"><i class="fas fa-network-wired me-1"></i>${u.ip}</div>`,

                `<div class="d-flex justify-content-between mb-1">
                <span class="text-primary small fw-semibold"><i class="fas fa-download me-1"></i>${Number(u.rx_mbps).toFixed(1)} M</span>
                <span class="text-info small fw-semibold"><i class="fas fa-upload me-1"></i>${Number(u.tx_mbps).toFixed(1)} M</span>
            </div>
            <div class="progress" style="height: 4px;">
                <div class="progress-bar bg-primary" style="width: ${rxPct}%;"></div>
                <div class="progress-bar bg-info" style="width: ${txPct}%;"></div>
            </div>
            <!-- Hidden sort value for DataTables -->
            <span style="display:none;">${totalBw.toFixed(5)}</span>`,

                `<div class="small text-muted"><i class="fas fa-clock me-1"></i>${u.uptime}</div>`,
                
                `<div class="text-end"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary rounded-pill px-3" onclick="openCustomerLiveChart('${u.user}')"><i class="fas fa-chart-line me-1"></i> Chart</button></div>`
            ]);
        });

        // Update DataTables smoothly
        liveTrafficTable.clear();
        liveTrafficTable.rows.add(rows);
        liveTrafficTable.draw(false); // false keeps current pagination
    }

    function loadHardwareData() {
        {% for device in devices %}
        fetch("{% url 'device_hardware_api' device.id %}")
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(d => {
                let errorHtml = '';
                if (d.status === 'error') {
                    errorHtml = `<div class="alert alert-danger border-0 shadow-sm p-2 mb-2 small rounded-3"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle me-1"></i> <strong>Connection Error:</strong> Could not connect to Mikrotik API. Please verify IP and credentials in the <a href="{% url 'device_list' %}" class="alert-link text-decoration-underline">Mikrotik Devices</a> tab.</div>`;
                }

                let cpu = d.cpu_load ? d.cpu_load + "%" : "-";
                let ram = "-";
                if (d.free_memory && d.total_memory) {
                    let freeM = parseFloat(d.free_memory);
                    let totM = parseFloat(d.total_memory);
                    let used = totM - freeM;
                    let pct = Math.round((used / totM) * 100);
                    ram = pct + "%";
                }
                let sto = "-";
                if (d.free_hdd_space && d.total_hdd_space) {
                    let freeH = parseFloat(d.free_hdd_space);
                    let totH = parseFloat(d.total_hdd_space);
                    let usedH = totH - freeH;
                    let pctH = Math.round((usedH / totH) * 100);
                    sto = pctH + "%";
                }
                let upt = d.uptime || "-";
                
                let hwItem = {
                    name: '{{ device.device_name }}',
                    status: d.status === 'error' ? 'Error' : 'Online',
                    cpu: cpu,
                    ram: ram,
                    disk: sto,
                    uptime: upt
                };
                let idx = currentHardwareData.findIndex(x => x.name === hwItem.name);
                if (idx > -1) { currentHardwareData[idx] = hwItem; }
                else { currentHardwareData.push(hwItem); }

                let existing = document.getElementById('hw-box-{{ device.id }}');
                let html = `
        <div id="hw-box-{{ device.id }}" class="mb-4">
            <div class="text-muted small mb-2 fw-bold">{{ device.device_name }}</div>
            ${errorHtml}
            <div class="hw-grid row text-center g-2">
                <div class="col-3"><div class="text-muted small text-uppercase">CPU</div><div class="fw-bold text-info">${cpu}</div></div>
                <div class="col-3"><div class="text-muted small text-uppercase">RAM</div><div class="fw-bold text-warning">${ram}</div></div>
                <div class="col-3"><div class="text-muted small text-uppercase">Disk</div><div class="fw-bold text-danger">${sto}</div></div>
                <div class="col-3"><div class="text-muted small text-uppercase">Uptime</div><div class="fw-bold text-success">${upt}</div></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        `;
                if (existing) { existing.outerHTML = html; }
                else { document.getElementById('hardwareList').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html); }
            });
        {% endfor %}
    }

    let currentPollId = 0;

    function openApplyAddonModal(requestId, customerId, customerName, addonType) {
        if (addonType !== 'Cignal Play Add-on' && !addonType.toLowerCase().includes('cignal')) {
            alert('This modal is only for Cignal Play Add-ons. Other add-ons must be handled manually.');
            return;
        }
        document.getElementById('modalCustomerName').innerText = customerName;
        document.getElementById('applyAddonForm').action = '/cignal-play/approve/' + requestId + '/';
        var myModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('applyAddonModal'));
        myModal.show();
    }

    function pollFastData(id) {
        let fastSpeed = parseInt(document.getElementById('interval').value);
        let selectedRouterIP = document.getElementById('routerFilter').value;
        fetch("{% url 'api_live_monitoring' %}")
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(d => {
                if (id !== currentPollId) return; // Drop old responses
                
                // --- Customer Modal Chart Logic ---
                if (modalCustomer) {
                    let targetUser = (d.users || []).find(u => u.user === modalCustomer);
                    if (targetUser) {
                        custRxData.shift(); custRxData.push(targetUser.rx_mbps);
                        custTxData.shift(); custTxData.push(targetUser.tx_mbps);
                        document.getElementById('modalRxText').innerText = Number(targetUser.rx_mbps).toFixed(1);
                        document.getElementById('modalTxText').innerText = Number(targetUser.tx_mbps).toFixed(1);
                        if (customerChartObj) customerChartObj.update();
                    }
                }
                
                // --- Router Filtering Logic ---
                if (selectedRouterIP === "ALL") {
                    allData = d.users || [];
                    document.getElementById('totalActiveSubs').innerText = d.total_active_subs || 0;
                } else {
                    allData = (d.users || []).filter(u => u.device_ip === selectedRouterIP);
                    document.getElementById('totalActiveSubs').innerText = allData.length;
                }
                
                maxRx = 0; maxTx = 0;
                allData.forEach(u => {
                    if (u.rx_mbps > maxRx) maxRx = u.rx_mbps;
                    if (u.tx_mbps > maxTx) maxTx = u.tx_mbps;
                });
                updateSummary();
                applyFilter();
            })
            .catch(err => console.error("Fast fetch error", err))
            .finally(() => {
                if (id === currentPollId) {
                    fastTimer = setTimeout(() => pollFastData(id), fastSpeed);
                }
            });
    }

    function pollSlowData() {
        let slowSpeed = 20000;
        fetch("{% url 'api_offline_users' %}")
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(d => renderOfflineCustomers(d.offline_users || []))
            .catch(err => console.error("Offline fetch error", err));

        fetch("{% url 'api_router_uplink' %}")
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(d => {
                let statusText = document.getElementById('uplinkStatus');
                if (statusText) statusText.classList.remove('syncing');

                if (d.routers && d.routers.length > 0) {
                    let r = d.routers[0];
                    let box = document.getElementById('kpi-uplink-box');
                    let pingText = document.getElementById('uplinkPing');
                    statusText.innerText = r.uplink_status;
                    pingText.innerText = "Ping: " + r.uplink_ping;

                    box.classList.remove('border-danger', 'border-warning', 'border-info', 'border-success');
                    box.style.setProperty('border-color', '', 'important');

                    if (r.uplink_status === 'Offline') {
                        box.classList.add('border-danger');
                    } else if (r.uplink_status === 'Unstable') {
                        box.classList.add('border-warning');
                    } else {
                        box.classList.add('border-info');
                    }
                }
            })
            .catch(err => {
                console.error("Uplink ping error", err);
                let box = document.getElementById('kpi-uplink-box');
                let statusText = document.getElementById('uplinkStatus');
                let pingText = document.getElementById('uplinkPing');
                if (statusText) {
                    statusText.innerText = "Error";
                    statusText.classList.remove('syncing');
                    pingText.innerText = "ping: failed";
                    if (box) {
                        box.classList.remove('border-info', 'border-warning', 'border-success');
                        box.classList.add('border-danger');
                    }
                }
            });

        loadHardwareData();
        loadNetworkAlerts();
        loadAddonRequests();

        slowTimer = setTimeout(pollSlowData, slowSpeed);
    }

    function startInterval() {
        currentPollId++; // Invalidate any pending fast loops
        loadNetworkAlerts();
        loadAddonRequests();
        if (fastTimer) clearTimeout(fastTimer);
        if (slowTimer) clearTimeout(slowTimer);
        pollFastData(currentPollId);
        pollSlowData();
    }

    document.getElementById('interval').addEventListener('change', startInterval);
    document.getElementById('routerFilter').addEventListener('change', () => {
        chartLabels = Array(20).fill('');
        rxChartData = Array(20).fill(0);
        txChartData = Array(20).fill(0);
        if (bandwidthChart) bandwidthChart.update();
        startInterval();
    });

    $(document).ready(function () {
        initChart();
        initCustomerChart();
        liveTrafficTable = $('#liveTrafficTable').DataTable({
            "paging": false,
            "info": false,
            "lengthChange": false,
            "order": [[1, "desc"]], // Sort by bandwidth descending by default
            "responsive": true,
            "dom": 'rt' // Only show processing (r) and table (t)
        });

        // Initialize Select2 for Customer Search
        $('#customerSearchSelect').select2({
            dropdownParent: $('#searchCustomerModal'),
            placeholder: "Search by Name...",
            allowClear: true,
            theme: 'bootstrap-5',
            width: '100%'
        });

        let searchInterval = null;
        $('#customerSearchSelect').on('change', function() {
            const customerId = $(this).val();
            const detailsDiv = document.getElementById('searchCustomerDetails');
            
            if (searchInterval) {
                clearInterval(searchInterval);
                searchInterval = null;
            }
            
            if (!customerId) {
                detailsDiv.style.display = 'none';
                return;
            }
            
            detailsDiv.style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('searchCustName').innerText = $(this).find("option:selected").text();
            document.getElementById('searchCustLink').href = '/customers/view/' + customerId + '/';
            
            function fetchCustomerLiveStatus() {
                fetch('/api/customer/' + customerId + '/mikrotik-status/')
                    .then(response => response.json())
                    .then(data => {
                        let statusColor = data.mt_status === 'Connected' ? 'text-success' : 'text-danger';
                        document.getElementById('searchCustStatus').innerHTML = `<span class="${statusColor}">${data.mt_status}</span>`;
                        document.getElementById('searchCustUptime').innerText = data.uptime !== 'N/A' ? data.uptime : (data.last_logged_out !== 'N/A' ? 'Offline since ' + data.last_logged_out : 'N/A');
                        document.getElementById('searchCustMac').innerText = data.live_mac;
                        
                        if (data.stability) {
                            document.getElementById('searchCustStability').innerHTML = `<span class="text-${data.stability_color}">${data.stability}</span>`;
                        } else {
                            document.getElementById('searchCustStability').innerText = 'N/A';
                        }
                        
                        if (data.rx_mbps !== undefined && data.tx_mbps !== undefined) {
                            document.getElementById('searchCustDl').innerText = data.tx_mbps + ' Mbps';
                            document.getElementById('searchCustUl').innerText = data.rx_mbps + ' Mbps';
                        } else {
                            document.getElementById('searchCustDl').innerText = '0.0 Mbps';
                            document.getElementById('searchCustUl').innerText = '0.0 Mbps';
                        }
                    })
                    .catch(error => console.error('Error fetching status:', error));
            }
            
            fetchCustomerLiveStatus();
            searchInterval = setInterval(fetchCustomerLiveStatus, 5000);
        });

        // Clear interval when modal closes
        $('#searchCustomerModal').on('hidden.bs.modal', function () {
            if (searchInterval) {
                clearInterval(searchInterval);
                searchInterval = null;
            }
            $('#customerSearchSelect').val('').trigger('change');
        });
        
        $('#customerLiveChartModal').on('hidden.bs.modal', function () {
            modalCustomer = null;
        });

        // Wire up custom search bar to DataTables
        $('#customSearch').on('keyup input', function () {
            liveTrafficTable.search(this.value).draw();
        });

        startInterval();
    });
</script>

<script>
    function toggleScopeInputs() {
        const scope = document.getElementById('healthScope').value;
        const routerGrp = document.getElementById('routerInputGroup');
        const barangayGrp = document.getElementById('barangayInputGroup');
        const customerGrp = document.getElementById('customerInputGroup');

        if (routerGrp) routerGrp.classList.add('d-none');
        if (barangayGrp) barangayGrp.classList.add('d-none');
        if (customerGrp) customerGrp.classList.add('d-none');
        
        if (scope === 'router' && routerGrp) {
            routerGrp.classList.remove('d-none');
        } else if (scope === 'barangay' && barangayGrp) {
            barangayGrp.classList.remove('d-none');
        } else if (scope === 'customer' && customerGrp) {
            customerGrp.classList.remove('d-none');
        }
    }
</script>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sweetalert2@11"></script>
<script>
function confirmAction(e, title, text, icon) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const form = e.target;
    const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark-mode');
    
    Swal.fire({
        title: title,
        text: text,
        icon: icon,
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: 'Yes, proceed',
        customClass: {
            popup: isDark ? `gt-modal-content gt-emotion-${icon}` : '',
            confirmButton: 'btn btn-primary rounded-pill px-4 shadow-sm',
            cancelButton: 'btn btn-secondary rounded-pill px-4 ms-2'
        },
        buttonsStyling: false,
        background: isDark ? 'rgba(13, 20, 40, 0.95)' : '#fff',
        color: isDark ? '#f8fafc' : '#1e293b'
    }).then((result) => {
        if (result.isConfirmed) {
            form.submit();
        }
    });
    return false;
</script>
<script>
function sendSingleAction(type) {
    const ids = [{{ customer.id }}];
    let payload = { customer_ids: ids };
    let endpoint = '';
    
    if (type === 'sms') {
        const msg = document.getElementById('singleSmsMessage').value;
        if(!msg) return alert("Message cannot be empty.");
        payload.message = msg;
        endpoint = '/customers/bulk-sms/';
    } else {
        const sub = document.getElementById('singleEmailSubject').value || 'Important Notice';
        const msg = document.getElementById('singleEmailMessage').value;
        if(!msg) return alert("Message cannot be empty.");
        payload.subject = sub;
        payload.message = msg;
        endpoint = '/customers/bulk-email/';
    }

    fetch(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'X-CSRFToken': '{{ csrf_token }}'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    })
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(data => {
        if(data.success) {
            alert(`Successfully sent message!`);
            location.reload();
        } else {
            alert("Error: " + data.error);
        }
    })
    .catch(err => {
        alert("Network error occurred.");
    });
}
</script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        // Initialize Bootstrap tooltips
        var tooltipTriggerList = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-toggle="tooltip"]'))
        var tooltipList = tooltipTriggerList.map(function (tooltipTriggerEl) {
            return new bootstrap.Tooltip(tooltipTriggerEl)
        });

        var lat = {{ customer.latitude|default:"null" }};
        var lng = {{ customer.longitude|default:"null" }};
        
        if (lat !== null && lng !== null) {
            var map = L.map('map').setView([lat, lng], 15);
            L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
                attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors'
            }).addTo(map);

            L.marker([lat, lng]).addTo(map)
                .bindPopup('<b>{{ customer.full_name }}</b>')
                .openPopup();
        } else {
            document.getElementById('map').innerHTML = '<div class="h-100 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center text-muted">No coordinates provided for this customer.</div>';
            document.getElementById('map').style.background = '#f8fafc';
        }
    });

</script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        const customerId = "{{ customer.id }}";
        
        // 1. Initialize Chart.js First
        const ctx = document.getElementById('liveTrafficChart').getContext('2d');
        const trafficChart = new Chart(ctx, {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
                labels: [],
                datasets: [
                    {
                        label: 'Download (Mbps)',
                        borderColor: '#38bdf8',
                        backgroundColor: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1)',
                        borderWidth: 2,
                        tension: 0.4,
                        fill: true,
                        data: []
                    },
                    {
                        label: 'Upload (Mbps)',
                        borderColor: '#fbbf24',
                        backgroundColor: 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.1)',
                        borderWidth: 2,
                        tension: 0.4,
                        fill: true,
                        data: []
                    }
                ]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                maintainAspectRatio: false,
                plugins: {
                    legend: { display: false },
                    tooltip: {
                        mode: 'index',
                        intersect: false,
                        backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9)'
                    }
                },
                scales: {
                    x: { display: false },
                    y: {
                        beginAtZero: true,
                        grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' },
                        ticks: { font: { size: 10 } }
                    }
                },
                interaction: {
                    mode: 'nearest',
                    axis: 'x',
                    intersect: false
                }
            }
        });

        // 2. Define and start Mikrotik Polling
        function fetchStatus() {
            fetch(`/customers/api/status/${customerId}/`)
                .then(response => {
                    if (!response.ok) {
                        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
                    }
                    return response.json();
                })
                .then(data => {
                    const statusContainer = document.getElementById('mt-status-container');
                    if (data.mt_status === 'Connected') {
                        statusContainer.innerHTML = '<span class="text-success"><i class="fas fa-circle me-1" style="font-size:0.6rem;"></i>Connected</span>';
                    } else {
                        statusContainer.innerHTML = '<span class="text-danger"><i class="fas fa-circle me-1" style="font-size:0.6rem;"></i>' + (data.mt_status || 'Error') + '</span>';
                    }

                    document.getElementById('mt-live-mac').innerText = data.live_mac;

                    const uptimeContainer = document.getElementById('uptime-container');
                    const lastLoggedOutContainer = document.getElementById('last-logged-out-container');
                    const stabilityBadge = document.getElementById('live-stability-badge');

                    if (data.mt_status === 'Connected') {
                        document.getElementById('mt-uptime').innerText = data.uptime;
                        uptimeContainer.style.display = 'flex';
                        lastLoggedOutContainer.style.display = 'none';
                        
                        if (data.stability && stabilityBadge) {
                            stabilityBadge.innerText = data.stability;
                            stabilityBadge.className = 'badge ms-2 bg-' + data.stability_color;
                            stabilityBadge.style.display = 'inline-block';
                        }
                        
                        if (data.rx_mbps !== undefined && data.tx_mbps !== undefined) {
                            document.getElementById('live-dl-val').innerHTML = data.rx_mbps + ' <span style="font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600;">Mbps</span>';
                            document.getElementById('live-ul-val').innerHTML = data.tx_mbps + ' <span style="font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600;">Mbps</span>';
                            
                            const now = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour12: false, hour: "numeric", minute: "numeric", second: "numeric" });
                            
                            if (typeof trafficChart !== 'undefined' && trafficChart !== null) {
                                trafficChart.data.labels.push(now);
                                trafficChart.data.datasets[0].data.push(parseFloat(data.rx_mbps)); // DL
                                trafficChart.data.datasets[1].data.push(parseFloat(data.tx_mbps)); // UL
                                
                                // Keep only last 15 points
                                if (trafficChart.data.labels.length > 15) {
                                    trafficChart.data.labels.shift();
                                    trafficChart.data.datasets[0].data.shift();
                                    trafficChart.data.datasets[1].data.shift();
                                }
                                trafficChart.update('none'); // Update without full animation
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (stabilityBadge) stabilityBadge.style.display = 'none';
                        if (data.last_logged_out !== 'N/A') {
                            document.getElementById('mt-last-logged-out').innerText = data.last_logged_out;
                            lastLoggedOutContainer.style.display = 'flex';
                        } else {
                            lastLoggedOutContainer.style.display = 'none';
                        }
                        uptimeContainer.style.display = 'none';
                        document.getElementById('live-dl-val').innerHTML = '0 <span style="font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600;">Mbps</span>';
                        document.getElementById('live-ul-val').innerHTML = '0 <span style="font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600;">Mbps</span>';
                    }
                })
                .catch(error => {
                    console.error("Error fetching Mikrotik status:", error);
                    document.getElementById('mt-status-container').innerHTML = '<span class="text-danger" title="' + error.message + '"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle me-1" style="font-size:0.6rem;"></i>Error</span>';
                    
                    const uptimeContainer = document.getElementById('uptime-container');
                    const lastLoggedOutContainer = document.getElementById('last-logged-out-container');
                    
                    if(uptimeContainer) uptimeContainer.style.display = 'none';
                    if(lastLoggedOutContainer) lastLoggedOutContainer.style.display = 'none';
                    
                    const macEl = document.getElementById('mt-live-mac');
                    if(macEl) macEl.innerText = 'N/A';
                });
        }

        fetchStatus();
        setInterval(fetchStatus, 5000);

        // 3. Auto-resolve Addon Request
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const resolveAddonId = urlParams.get('resolve_addon');
        if (resolveAddonId) {
            fetch('{% url "resolve_addon_request_api" %}', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'X-CSRFToken': '{{ csrf_token }}'
                },
                body: JSON.stringify({ request_id: resolveAddonId })
            })
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                if(data.status === 'success') {
                    const editBtn = document.querySelector('a.btn-edit[href*="/edit/"]');
                    if(editBtn) {
                        editBtn.classList.remove('btn-edit');
                        editBtn.classList.add('bg-danger', 'text-white', 'pulse-animation');
                        editBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle"></i> Complete Add-on Here';
                        alert("Add-on Application processed!\nPlease click the 'Complete Add-on Here' button to update the customer's Cignal Play details.");
                    }
                    window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
                }
            });
        }
    });
</script>

--- FILE: .\billing\templatetags\log_filters.py ---
from django import template
from django.utils.safestring import mark_safe

register = template.Library()


@register.filter
def format_log_details(log):
    sentences = []
    old_data = str(log.old_data).strip() if log.old_data else ""
    new_data = str(log.new_data).strip() if log.new_data else ""
    action = str(log.action).upper()

    if old_data == "null":
        old_data = ""
    if new_data == "null":
        new_data = ""

    bg_class = (
        "bg-danger-subtle text-danger" if action == "DELETE" else "bg-light text-dark"
    )
    border_class = "border-danger-subtle" if action == "DELETE" else "border-light"

    html = f"<div class='p-3 rounded-3 {bg_class} {border_class} border' style='font-size: 0.85rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif;'>"
    html += "<table class='table table-sm table-borderless mb-0' style='background: transparent;'>"
    html += "<tbody>"

    # Action: DELETE
    if action == "DELETE" and old_data:
        parts = {}
        for line in old_data.split("\n"):
            if ":" in line:
                k, v = line.split(":", 1)
                parts[k.strip()] = v.strip().replace("'", "")

        if "Amount" in parts:
            amt = parts.get("Amount", "")
            method = parts.get("Method", "")
            ref = parts.get("Reference", "")
            html += f"<tr><td class='text-danger p-0 fw-medium'><i class='fas fa-exclamation-triangle me-2'></i> Deleted {method} Payment of ₱{amt} (Ref: {ref})</td></tr>"
        else:
            for k, v in parts.items():
                html += f"<tr><td class='p-0 text-danger fw-semibold' style='width: 120px;'>{k}:</td><td class='p-0 text-danger'>{v}</td></tr>"

    # Action: ADD / UPDATE
    else:
        # Case 1: Profile update with -> or → (arrow format)
        if "→" in old_data or "->" in old_data:
            lines = old_data.split("\n")
            for line in lines:
                line = line.strip()
                if not line:
                    continue
                if "→" in line or "->" in line:
                    sep = "→" if "→" in line else "->"
                    parts = line.split(":", 1)
                    if len(parts) == 2:
                        key = parts[0].strip()
                        old_val, new_val = parts[1].split(sep, 1)
                        old_val = old_val.strip().replace("'", "")
                        new_val = new_val.strip().replace("'", "")
                        html += f"<tr><td class='p-1 fw-semibold text-muted' style='width: 100px;'>{key}:</td><td class='p-1'><span class='text-muted text-decoration-line-through me-2'>{old_val}</span> <i class='fas fa-arrow-right text-muted mx-2' style='font-size: 0.7rem;'></i> <span class='text-success fw-medium'>{new_val}</span></td></tr>"

        # Case 2: Key-value Updates (no arrows)
        elif "UPDATE" in action and old_data and new_data:
            old_dict = {}
            for line in old_data.split("\n"):
                if ":" in line:
                    k, v = line.split(":", 1)
                    old_dict[k.strip()] = v.strip().replace("'", "")
            new_dict = {}
            for line in new_data.split("\n"):
                if ":" in line:
                    k, v = line.split(":", 1)
                    new_dict[k.strip()] = v.strip().replace("'", "")

            for key, new_val in new_dict.items():
                old_val = old_dict.get(key)
                if old_val and old_val != new_val:
                    html += f"<tr><td class='p-1 fw-semibold text-muted' style='width: 100px;'>{key}:</td><td class='p-1'><span class='text-muted text-decoration-line-through me-2'>{old_val}</span> <i class='fas fa-arrow-right text-muted mx-2' style='font-size: 0.7rem;'></i> <span class='text-success fw-medium'>{new_val}</span></td></tr>"
                elif not old_val:
                    html += f"<tr><td class='p-1 fw-semibold text-muted' style='width: 100px;'>{key}:</td><td class='p-1'><span class='text-success fw-medium'>{new_val}</span></td></tr>"

        # Case 3: Addition
        elif action == "ADD" and new_data:
            lines = new_data.split("\n")
            for line in lines:
                if ":" in line:
                    key, val = line.split(":", 1)
                    val = val.strip().replace("'", "")
                    html += f"<tr><td class='p-1 fw-semibold text-muted' style='width: 100px;'>{key.strip()}:</td><td class='p-1 text-success fw-medium'>{val}</td></tr>"

        # Fallback
        if "<tr>" not in html:
            if (
                new_data
                and new_data != "None"
                and "Profile updated via UI" not in new_data
            ):
                html += f"<tr><td class='p-0 text-muted'>{new_data}</td></tr>"
            elif old_data and old_data != "None":
                html += f"<tr><td class='p-0 text-muted'>{old_data}</td></tr>"
            else:
                html += "<tr><td class='p-0 text-muted fst-italic'>No additional details</td></tr>"

    html += "</tbody></table></div>"
    return mark_safe(html)


@register.filter
def get_initials(name):
    if not name:
        return ""
    parts = name.split()
    if len(parts) >= 2:
        return (parts[0][0] + parts[1][0]).upper()
    elif len(parts) == 1:
        return parts[0][:2].upper()
    return "U"

from django import template

register = template.Library()


@register.simple_tag
def get_elided_page_range(page_obj):
    if not page_obj:
        return []
    return page_obj.paginator.get_elided_page_range(
        page_obj.number, on_each_side=2, on_ends=1
    )

--- FILE: .\billing\views\analytics.py ---
from django.shortcuts import render
from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from billing.decorators import role_required
from billing.models import Customer, SubscriptionPlan
from django.db.models import Sum, Count, Q
from django.utils import timezone
from datetime import timedelta


@login_required
@role_required(["Admin", "Superadmin"])
def analytics_dashboard(request):
    # Total Active Customers
    active_customers = Customer.objects.filter(status="active").count()

    # Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) - Sum of all active plans prices
    mrr = (
        Customer.objects.filter(status="active", plan__isnull=False).aggregate(
            total_mrr=Sum("plan__price")
        )["total_mrr"]
        or 0
    )

    # Churn Rate proxy - Users who were suspended or inactive
    churned_customers = Customer.objects.filter(
        status__in=["suspended", "inactive"]
    ).count()

    # Plan distribution for Chart
    plan_distribution = list(
        SubscriptionPlan.objects.annotate(
            user_count=Count("customer", filter=Q(customer__status="active"))
        ).values("name", "user_count")
    )

    # Recent signups (last 30 days)
    thirty_days_ago = timezone.now() - timedelta(days=30)
    recent_signups = Customer.objects.filter(created_at__gte=thirty_days_ago).count()

    context = {
        "active_customers": active_customers,
        "mrr": mrr,
        "churned_customers": churned_customers,
        "recent_signups": recent_signups,
        "plan_distribution": plan_distribution,
    }

    return render(request, "billing/analytics.html", context)
